Name: A Clown in Town
Description: Rue the day you crossed a fey. You were cruel to Dolly Thrice; now you'll have to pay the price. This condition can only be obtained by smashing the Moonlantern held by Kar'niss. Applies clown makeup to the victim.

Name: A Mist Most Scarlet
Description: Orin has gained 25 temporary hit points, a +2 bonus to Strength, and advantage on Wisdom  Saving throws.

Name: A Most Bloody Inheritance
Description: The Dread Lord Bhaal looks favourably on his chosen. You can cast  Stunning Gaze and your Critical Hit Attack Roll requirement is reduced by 2. This effect can stack.

Name: Aberrant Shape
Description: Your Intellect Devourer form has 21 Hit Points. You gain the  Claws,  Devour Intellect, and  Synaptic Discharge abilities.

Name: Ability Drain: Dexterity
Description: Dexterity reduced by  Ability Drain

Name: Ability Drain: Strength
Description: Strength reduced by  Ability Drain.

Name: Abjure Enemy: Frightened
Description: The affected creature cannot move. Frightened creatures also have  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and Attack rolls.

Name: Abjure Enemy: Slow
Description: The affected creature's Movement speed is halved. Taking damage ends this condition.

Name: Absolute Consumption
Description: All of the creature's abilities are reduced by 5. When this effect ends, it drops  Prone

Name: Absolute's Enemy
Description: Enemies have  Advantage on attacks against you.

Name: Absorb Elements: Acid Damage
Description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d6Acid damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

Name: Absorb Elements: Cold Damage
Description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d6Cold damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

Name: Absorb Elements: Fire Damage
Description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d6Fire damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

Name: Absorb Elements: Lightning Damage
Description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d6Lightning damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

Name: Absorb Elements: Thunder Damage
Description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d6Thunder damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

Name: Absorbed Essence: Abazigal
Description: Sarevok's attacks deal maximum damage.

Name: Absorbed Essence: Amelyssan
Description: Sarevok's attacks now heal him by 2d12hit points each time.

Name: Absorbed Essence: Illasera
Description: Sarevok is permanently  Hastened and can't be  Paralysed,  Restrained, or have his movement speed reduced in any way.

Name: Absorbed Essence: Sendai
Description: Sarevok's Armour Class Armour Class is increased by 6.

Name: Absorbed Intellect
Description: Intelligence is being reduced by 1.

Name: Acid
Description: Reduces Armour Class by 2.

Name: Acid Infusion
Description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d4Acid the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

Name: Acid Reflux
Description: Acid damage has spoiled Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Acidic Regurgitation.

Name: Acid Resistance
Description: Resistant to Acid damage.

Name: Acid Resistance Aura
Description: The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to Acid damage.

Name: Action Surge
Description: Can take an extra Action this turn.

Name: Adamantine Reverberation
Description: While it has temporary hit points, this creature's movement speed is doubled. Immediately after losing these temporary hit points, the creature knocks back foes  4 m / 13 ft with a shockwave that deals 4d8Thunder.

Name: Adrip with Kereska's Acid
Description: Affected entity has resistance to Acid damage. Its acid spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus. When it deals spell damage, it possibly inflict 3 turns of  Noxious Fumes upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's acid it can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Hunger of Hadar at 5th level once per short rest.

Name: Adroit Caster
Description: Cantrips targeting foes and allies can target an additional creature. The same target can be chosen twice.

Name: Aegis of the Absolute
Description: The Netherbrain is Immune to all types of damage it took in the previous round until the start of its next turn.

Name: Against All Odds
Description: The unlikely actions of the party in the Morphic Pool were a surprise to even the Netherbrain. The successful roll has left the Netherbrain wounded, reducing its starting HP for the encounter.

Name: Agitated
Description: The rothé is nervous and afraid - ready to attack at the slightest scare. Has  Advantage on Attack rolls.

Name: Aid (5)
Description: Hit point maximum increased by 5 hit points. Hit point maximum increases by a further 5hit points for every Spell Slot Level above 2 used.

Name: Aid (10)
Description: Hit point maximum increased by 10 hit points.

Name: Aid (15)
Description: Hit point maximum increased by 15 hit points.

Name: Aid (20)
Description: Hit point maximum increased by 20 hit points.

Name: Aid (25)
Description: Hit point maximum increased by 25 hit points.

Name: Alarmed Debtor
Description: This creature has spotted you as an intruder.

Name: Alcohol
Skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Arcana, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
Description: Has  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.

Name: Alternate Form: Dire Wolf
Description: Transformed into a Dire Wolf in all the ways that matter.

Name: Alternate Form: Minotaur
Description: Transformed into a Minotaur in all the ways that matter.

Name: Alternate Form: Phase Spider
Description: Transformed into a Phase Spider in all the ways that matter.

Name: Alternate Form: Shadow Mastiff
Description: Transformed into a Shadow Mastiff in all the ways that matter.

Name: Ambushed
Skills: Athletics, Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Arcana
Description: Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage and it has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Checks. Taking damage or being Helped ends this condition.

Name: Ambushing
Description: Affected entity will attack as soon as its enemies are within reach. It can only be spotted with a successful Perception Check.

Name: Ambushing Bite
Description: The creature's next bite may  Ambush its target.

Name: Ancient Grudges
Description: Filled with a touch of arcane gith knowledge. Has  Advantage on Attack Rolls against aberrations.

Name: Animalistic Vitality
Description: Affected entity regains 2d8hit points of health every round when below 60 HP. It also receives an additional  3.5 m / 12 ft of movement speed.

Name: Anointed in Splendour
Description: Has a +2 bonus to all Saving throw Saving throws.

Name: Ansur's Ire
Description: A storm of vicious lightning is soon to erupt - striking all standing in the open.

Name: Aquatic Siphon
Description: A nearby water myrmidon grants the affected entity Immunity to Cold damage and an additional 3d8Cold damage to  Elemental Retort. The affected entity also gains temporary access to  Cone of Cold and an additional  Reaction per turn.

Name: Arcane Acuity
Description: Affected entity has a +1 bonus to its spell Attack rolls and spell save DC for each remaining turn. Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity takes damage. Arcane Acuity has a maximum  Duration: 10 turns.

Name: Arcane Ammunition
Description: Ranged weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4Force.

Name: Arcane Battery
Description: Affected entity's next spell doesn't cost a spell slot in order to cast.

Name: Arcane Charge
Description: While damaging  Threatened entities, deal +2 bonus to damage with spells.

Name: Arcane Critical
Description: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 2. This effect can stack.

Name: Arcane Hunger
Description: Gale's spirit is being drained. He has  Disadvantage to Constitution  Saving throws.

Name: Arcane Lock
Description: Locked through magical means. Can't be opened by lockpicking or the use of  Knock.

Name: Arcane Synergy
Description: Weapon attacks deal additional damage equal to affected entity's Spell Casting Ability Modifier.

Name: Arcane Ward
Description: Your Arcane Ward blocks damage equal to its charges and then loses 1 charge. Casting Abjuration spells will add charges equal to the level of the spell.

Name: Ardent Apostle
Description: Offering their cries of pain without protection. Has a +4 bonus to Performance and Intimidation checks.

Name: Armour of Agathys
Description: Gained  5 × spell level temporary hit points. If hit with a melee attack, the attacker takes 5 × spell levelCold damage. This effect ends when the temporary hit points are lost.

Name: Armour of the Swarm
Description: Your swarm grants you a +2 bonus to your  Armour Class until the start of your next turn.

Name: Arms of Hadar
Description: Can't take  Reactions.

Name: Arrow of Ilmater
Description: Cannot regain Hit Points

Name: Arsonist's Oil
Description: Affected entity has been stripped of its Fire Resistance.

Name: Ascended Fiend
Description: Raphael has gorged on souls and enhanced his fiendish powers, granting him an even deadlier array of spells and abilities. In this form,  Soul Overcharge will not prevent him from using Souls to cast spells.

Name: Aspect of the Elk
Description: Movement Speed increased by  +1.5 m / 5 ft, as long as the affected entity stays near the barbarian.

Name: Aspect of the Elk Aura
Description: Affected entity and nearby allies have a  +1.5 m / 5 ft bonus to Movement Speed.

Name: Aspect of the Stallion
Description: Gained Barbarian Level * 2  temporary hit points.

Name: Aspect of the Wolf
Description: Affected entity has a +Dexterity Modifier bonus to Stealth Checks, as long as it stays near the barbarian.

Name: Aspect of the Wolf Aura
Description: Affected entity and nearby allies have a +Dexterity Modifier bonus to Stealth Checks.

Name: Assassin's Blood
Description: Creature must succeed a Constitution  Saving throw or take 1d12Poison and get Poisoned until the next Long Rest. On a successful save, it still takes half damage.

Name: Astral Conduit
Description: The affected entity can't move, take actions, bonus actions, or reactions while holding open the Astral Rift, but can Summon an ally every other turn.

Name: Astral Gravity
Description: Gravity on the Astral Plane is different than on Faerûn. The affected entity is Immune to Falling damage and its Jump distance is tripled. Carrying capacity is tripled.

Name: Astral Knowledge
Description: Has Proficiency in all Skills of a chosen Ability.

Name: Astral Knowledge: Charisma
Description: Has Proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, Performance, and Persuasion.

Name: Astral Knowledge: Dexterity
Description: Has Proficiency in Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth.

Name: Astral Knowledge: Intelligence
Description: Has Proficiency in Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, and Religion.

Name: Astral Knowledge: Strength
Description: Has Proficiency in Athletics.

Name: Astral Knowledge: Wisdom
Description: Has Proficiency in Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, and Survival.

Name: At Death's Door (Emergent)
Description: Emergent Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 2. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.

Name: At Death's Door
Description: The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.

Name: At Death's Door (Moderate)
Description: Moderate Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 4. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.

Name: At Death's Door (Advanced)
Description: Advanced Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 6. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.

Name: Atrophied
Description: One of the affected entity's Abilities has been reduced to 0, causing it to die instantly.

Name: Auntie Ethel's Special Brew
Description: The affected creature takes 2d6Poison at the start of every turn until passing a DC 13  Constitution saving throw.

Name: Aura of Bloodthirst
Description: Any nearby creatures with the Rampage trait can make a bite attack as a bonus action.

Name: Aura of Brutality
Description: All servants of  Bane around this character gain an additional +1 Strength. This effect can stack.

Name: Aura of Conquest
Description: Frightened enemies within  3 m / 10 ft take 5Psychic damage per turn.

Name: Aura of Courage (Aura)
Description: The paladin and any nearby allies can't be  Frightened.

Name: Aura of Courage
Description: Can't be  Frightened within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

Name: Aura of Devotion (Aura)
Description: The paladin and any nearby allies can't be  Charmed.

Name: Aura of Devotion
Description: Can't be  Charmed within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

Name: Aura of Hate (Aura)
Description: The Paladin and all nearby fiends and undead deal additional damage with melee weapons, equal to the Charisma modifier of the Paladin.

Name: Aura of Hate
Description: Deals an additional +Charisma modifier to damage dealt with melee weapons within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

Name: Aura of Murder (Aura)
Description: Enemies within 3 m / 10 ft are Vulnerable to Piercing damage, unless they are Immune to it.

Name: Aura of Murder
Description: Affected entity is Vulnerable to Piercing damage.

Name: Aura of Possibility
Description: While near the God of Ambition, this creature has a +10 bonus to all Ability Checks.

Name: Aura of Possibility (Aura)
Description: Any allies near Gale Dekarios, the God of Ambition, receive a +10 bonus to all Ability Checks.

Name: Aura of Protection (Aura)
Description: The paladin and any nearby allies have a +Charisma modifier bonus on Saving Throws.

Name: Aura of Protection
Description: Gains a bonus to saving throws equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.

Name: Aura of Terror (Aura)
Description: Nearby enemies have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and  Saving throws. Creatures that can't be  Frightened are immune to this aura.

Name: Aura of Terror
Description: Bane's oppressive aura gives the affected entity  Disadvantage on attack rolls and  Saving throws while within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

Name: Aura of Vile Oblivion
Description: All nearby light sources get extinguished when the Wraith is nearby.

Name: Aura of Warding (Aura)
Description: The paladin and any nearby allies have Resistance to damage from spells.

Name: Aura of Warding
Description: Resistant to damage from spells within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

Name: Avatar of BOOOAL
Description: The sight of a kuo-toa servant dying fills BOOOAL with bloodlust. It regains 3d6hit points when it kills a creature and can attack three times.

Name: Avatar of Tyranny
Description: Bane has come to Gortash's aid! Gortash has  150 temporary hit points,  Advantage on  Strength checks and  Strength saving throws... And now has fearsome new powers! Affected entity gains an extra 1d4Physical damage to weapon attacks and Immunity to Thunder, Fire, and Force damage.

Name: Aversion of Fire
Description: Recently suffered Fire damage. Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.

Name: Baleful Knowledge
Skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
Description: Dark whispers pervade the creature's mind.  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.

Name: Bane
Description: Has a  -1d4 penalty to  Attack rolls and Saving throws.

Name: Bane's Brutality
Description: Affected entity gains +1 to its Strength ability. This effect can stack.

Name: Bane's Command
Description: This creature can channel  Bane's Wrath - it is the Black Hand's will.

Name: Baneful Strike
Description: Affected entity has a -1d4 penalty to  Saving throws against its attacker's next spell.

Name: Banished
Description: Banished from this plane of existence. Can't be targeted. Can't move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions

Name: Bardic Inspiration
Description: Can use  Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d6 bonus to the next Attack roll,  Ability check, or  Saving throw. Bonus depends on originating Bard's level Grants:  Bardic Roll (Toggleable Passive Feature): +1d6 bonus to the next  Ability check.  Bardic Defence (Reaction): +1d6 bonus to the next  Saving throw.  Bardic Attack (Reaction): +1d6 bonus to the next Attack roll.

Name: Barkskin
Description: Armour Class increased to 16.

Name: Beacon of Hope
Description: Has Advantage on Wisdom and Death  Saving throws. Regains the maximum possible Hit Points when healed.

Name: Bear's Endurance
Description: Has  Advantage on Constitution Checks. Gain 7 Temporary Hit Points.

Name: Beckoning Darkness
Description: Haunted by darkness. Affected entity takes 2d8Necrotic damage if it enters or starts its turn in a Lightly or Heavily Obscured area.

Name: Befuddled
Description: Affected entity can't control its actions and wanders around without direction.

Name: Beguiled
Description: This creature has been charmed by Raphael and cannot target him with attacks or spells.

Name: Bend Luck: Ability Check Bonus
Description: Wild magic has twisted the affected entity's fate. It gained a +1d4 bonus to  Ability Checks.

Name: Bend Luck: Ability Check Penalty
Description: Wild magic has twisted the affected entity's fate. It gained a -1d4 penalty to  Ability Checks.

Name: Benign Transposition: Spent
Description: Affected entity has used its  Benign Transposition feature for the day. To replenish this feature, the entity must cast a Conjuration spell of Level 1 or higher.

Name: Berserk
Description: A frenetic rage racks the affected entity's flesh. Its Multiattacks each deal an additional 1d8Bludgeoning damage and knocks targets  Prone It also gains Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage, and has  Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws. This frenzy ends if the affected entity regains all its hit points.

Name: Bhaal's Boon
Description: Bhaal revels in the affected entity's gift for murder, granting it a +1 bonus to  Armour Class per marked kill. 1 point of this bonus Armour Class is lost each time the Slayer avoids an attack.

Name: Bhaal's Edict
Description: If you don't kill another creature before the end of your next turn, you will die instantly.

Name: Bhaal's Murderous Mark
Description: Affected entity's death grants a +1  Armour Class bonus to the Slayer.

Name: Bhaalist Ritual Target
Description: As part of the challenge to enter the temple, the affected entity has become the target of a chanting cultist, the Farslayer, who can cast  Bhaal's Power Word Kill once its profane ritual ends. Exiting the Farslayer's chanting range of  55 m / 183 ft makes you invulnerable to the effect. Slaying the Farslayer stops the ritual and wins the conflict.

Name: Bhaalspawn Essence: Abazigal
Description: When Abazigal's ghost dies, Sarevok will absorb his essence and deal maximum damage on all his attacks.

Name: Bhaalspawn Essence: Amelyssan
Description: When Amelyssan's ghost dies, Sarevoks attacks will heal him for 2d12hit points

Name: Bhaalspawn Essence: Illasera
Description: When Illasera's ghost dies, Sarevok will be permanently  Hastened and will be unaffected by Paralysis, Restraints, or any attempts to reduce his movement speed.

Name: Bhaalspawn Essence: Sendai
Description: When Sendai's ghost dies, Sarevok will have his  Armour Class increased by 6.

Name: Big Pig
Description: Pigs are smart and pigs are fun - that's why Dolly made you one!

Name: Black Hole
Description: The black hole pulls nearby creatures and deals 7~34Force damage. The nearby area is Difficult Terrain and can  Slow creatures within it.  Intelligence saving throw

Name: Black Tentacles
Description: Restrained by dark tendrils. Affected entity can't move and takes 3d6Bludgeoning damage per turn. Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage

Name: Blacked Out
Description: Thisobald has overindulged in his own brew. He is Vulnerable to Slashing, Piercing, Bludgeoning and Thunder Damage.

Name: Blade Barrier
Description: Creatures that approach the barrier are slit and sliced and cut and carved like so much meat on a blood-grouted block. Affected entities take 6d10Slashing damage per turn.

Name: Blade Ward
Description: Has Resistance against Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

Name: Bladesinging
Description: Invoking the Bladesong. You gain a +2/+3/+4 bonus to  Armour Class and your movement speed is increased by 3 m / 10 ft. You also gain  Advantage in Acrobatics and a +2/+3/+4 bonus to Constitution  Saving throws. The AC and saving throws bonus is +2, +3, or +4 at Bladesinger levels 2, 5, or 9 respectively.

Name: Bladesong Damage Charge
Description: A charge that will increase how much damage you deal to enemies by 1d6Force when using  Bladesong Climax. You can accumulate these charges by casting Level 1 spells or above that are not weapon attacks.

Name: Bladesong Healing Charge
Description: A charge that increases how much you heal yourself and your allies by 1d6hit points when using  Bladesong Climax. You can accumulate these charges by attacking with weapons.

Name: Bladesong Impeded
Description: Bladesinging impeded by armour/shield/weapon. Until the armour/shield/weapon is removed, your  Bladesong won't grant any benefits or let you generate Bladesong Charges.

Name: Blazing Retaliation
Description: When a melee attack misses it, deal 1d6Fire damage to the attacker.

Name: Bleeding
Description: Creature takes 2Slashing damage at the start of each turn and has  Disadvantage on Constitution  Saving throws. Removed by healing.

Name: Bless
Description: Gains a  +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and Saving throws.

Name: Blessing of Selûne
Description: Selûne's radiance protects you against the lesser effects of the  Shadow Curse. But beware - even Her light cannot guard against the darkest shadows. Permits safe passage through some of the Shadow-Cursed Lands without a light source. Resistant to magical Necrotic damage.

Name: Blessing of the Trickster
Description: Has  Advantage on Stealth Checks.

Name: Blinded
Description: The affected creature has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls. The affected creature's range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m / 10 ft. Attack rolls against affected creatures have  Advantage.

Name: Blinded (Blinding Smite)
Description: The affected creature has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls. Ranged attacks and spells of the affected creature have a range of  3 m / 10 ft. Attack Rolls against affected creatures have  Advantage. At the end of each turn, the affected creature makes a  Constitution saving throw. If successful, the condition is removed.

Name: Blindness
Description: The affected creature has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls. Ranged attacks and spells of the affected creature have a range of  3 m / 10 ft. Attack Rolls against affected creatures have  Advantage. At the end of each turn, the affected creature makes a  Constitution saving throw. If successful, the condition is removed.

Name: Blink
Description: At the end of each turn, there is a chance the affected entity gets  Blinked to the Ethereal Plane, where it can't be harmed, seen or affected. While in the Ethereal Plane, the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can only choose to teleport up to  6 m / 20 ft. When combat ends, so does this effect.

Name: Blinked to the Ethereal Plane
Description: Affected entity is in the Ethereal Plane, where it can't be harmed, seen, or affected. While in the Ethereal Plane, the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can choose to teleport up to 6m / 20ft. At the end of each turn, there is a chance it reappears in the Material Plane. When combat ends, so does this effect.

Name: Bliss Spores
Description: Affected entity has a +1d6 bonus to  Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, and  Saving throws until the next Long Rest.

Name: Bloated
Description: Restrained due to sickness and bloat.

Name: Blocked by Bhaalist Mischief
Description: This door cannot be opened until the Farslayer is defeated.

Name: Blocked Warrens
Description: Kobolds cannot emerge from this tunnel while it is obstructed.

Name: Blood-draw Sickness
Description: Nothing is ever free - until the next long rest the affected entity has a -1 to all dice rolls.

Name: Blood-Sapped
Description: Hit point maximum reduced by 8 per turn remaining. Creature will die if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

Name: Blood-scent Frenzy
Description: Affected entity has  Advantage on melee attacks against any target that doesn't have all of its hit points, provided it's not a construct, an ooze, a plant, or an elemental.

Name: Bloodless
Description: Feels a bit woozy. -1 to all Attack Rolls, Saving Throws, and most Ability Checks. Disappears after Long Rest. Can be cured by Lesser Restoration, Remove Curse and Lay on Hands: Cure.

Name: Bloodlust
Description: Creature can attack three times. It regains 3d8hit points if it lands a killing blow.

Name: Bloodthirst
Description: Gains  Bite as a bonus action.

Name: Bloody Favour
Description: Bhaal's Chosen will be granted a profane boon at the start of every turn.

Name: Blooming Dead
Description: This Undead heals 4d6hit points at the start of every turn while it is within  The Dead Wastes.

Name: Bludgeon the Weak
Description: Affected entity is Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage for 3 turns, or until it takes damage.

Name: Blurred
Description: Attackers have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against this creature, unless they do not rely on sight or can see through illusions.

Name: Bolstering Brew
Description: Affected entity's Strength score is increased by 6 while it is infused with Thisobald's current brew.

Name: Bolstering Magic: Boon
Description: Bolstered by wild magic. Has a  +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Ability Checks

Name: Bone Chilled
Description: Can not regain  hit points. Cannot help  Downed characters. If Undead, has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls.

Name: Booming Blade
Description: Affected entity will take 1d8Thunder damage when it moves.

Name: Boon of Servitude
Description: Regains 2d4+Spellcasting Modifierhit points each turn.

Name: BOOOAL's Benediction
Description: Advantage on Attack rolls against Bleeding creatures, as long as there are Kuo-toa to worship BOOOAL.

Name: BOOOAL's Blessing
Description: The wielder has  Advantage on Attack rolls against Bleeding creatures, as long as there are Kuo-toa to worship BOOOAL.

Name: BOOOAL's Faithful
Description: Chance to apply  Bleeding to targets.

Name: Bottled Breath
Description: Affected Entity is able to cast  Gust of Wind once per long rest.

Name: Bound
Description: This relic is bound to its current owner by a powerful aura. Bound items cannot be removed from your inventory.

Name: Bound Weapon
Description: Ritually bound to its wielder. The weapon can't be knocked out of the wielder's hand, and automatically returns to its wielder when thrown.

Name: Braced
Description: On Damage Rolls, roll twice and use the higher result.

Name: Brain-Starved
Description: The Creature's Ability Scores are reduced by 10 while wracked with a ravening hunger for brain matter.

Name: Brand of the Silverlight
Description: This creature's weapon attacks deal an additional 5d8Radiant damage.

Name: Branding Smite
Description: Cannot turn Invisible.

Name: Breathless Lungs
Description: Mystic Carrion can't be  Silenced while his lungs are still intact.

Name: Brew Sickness
Description: While in the vicinity of Thisobald's  Spoiled Brew, this creature takes 1d6Necrotic every turn.

Name: Brewed-Up Bellyglummer
Description: Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks Affected entity takes 1d6Poison damage at the end of its next turn.

Name: Brittle
Description: 2d6 (2~12) Cold  damage per turn Affected entity has been rapidly cooled while aflame, making it Vulnerable to Thunder and Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Broken Promises
Description: Strength is increased by 2 for  Duration: Until Long rest. Strength is decreased indefinitely by 1 after Long Rest.

Name: Browbeaten
Description: Affected entity has a +1 bonus to spell save DC while threatened.

Name: Bufotoxin
Description: Has  Disadvantage on  Dexterity saving throws.

Name: Bull's Strength
Description: Has  Advantage on Strength Checks. Weight Limit doubled.

Name: Burden of Time
Description: A nearby shadar-kai is imposing  Disadvantage on this creature's  Saving throws.

Name: Burden of Time Aura
Description: Beasts and Humanoids have  Disadvantage on Saving Throws while within  3 m / 10 ft of this creature. Elves are unaffected by this temporal magic.

Name: Burned Out Optics
Description: Affected entity's optical lens has been distorted, causing its vision become impaired. Entity recieves 1d6 penalty to Attack Rolls.

Name: Burning
Description: Takes 1d4Fire damage per turn. Can be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Potion or gaining  Wet. Immune from if  Wet.  Dip action can be used on Burning characters or objects.

Name: Burning (Orthonic)
Description: Takes 1d4Fire damage per turn. CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet.

Name: Burning Acid
Description: The hatchery waters burn through all those who'd intrude upon it.

Name: Burning Fiercely
Description: Takes 1d10Fire damage per turn.

Name: Burning Reflux
Description: Fire damage has ignited Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Fiery Regurgitation.

Name: Burst of Accuracy
Description: You have a +1d4 bonus to attack rolls after using Action Surge.

Name: Buthir's Wrath
Resistance: Slashing, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Buthir is enraged! Strength increased by 4 and Armour Class reduced by 2. Tactician Difficulty: Buthir is enraged! Strength increased by 4, and has Resistance to all physical damage.

Name: Call Lightning
