Description: Channelling primordial might. Until the end of your  Rage, your weapon will deal an additional 1d6Cold and gain the  Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.

Name: Elemental Cleaver: Fire
Description: Channelling primordial might. Until the end of your  Rage, your weapon will deal an additional 1d6Fire and gain the  Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.

Name: Elemental Cleaver: Lightning
Description: Channelling primordial might. Until the end of your  Rage, your weapon will deal an additional 1d6Lightning and gain the  Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.

Name: Elemental Cleaver: Thunder
Description: Channelling primordial might. Until the end of your  Rage, your weapon will deal an additional 1d6Thunder and gain the  Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.

Name: Elemental Weapon: Acid
Description: Has a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4Acid damage.

Name: Elemental Weapon: Cold
Description: Has a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4Cold damage.

Name: Elemental Weapon: Fire
Description: Has a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4Fire damage.

Name: Elemental Weapon: Lightning
Description: Has a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4Lightning damage.

Name: Elemental Weapon: Thunder
Description: Has a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4Thunder damage.

Name: Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
Description: Has an additional  Level 1 Spell Slot.

Name: Elixir of Barkskin
Description: Armour Class increased to 16.

Name: Elixir of Battlemage's Power
Description: Affected entity has  Arcane Acuity until its next Long Rest. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.Gain Arcane Acuity for  Duration: 3 turns. Arcane Acuity cannot go below  Duration: 3 turns.

Name: Elixir of Bloodlust
Description: Affected entity has entered a murderous state of bloodlust. Once per turn, when it kills an enemy, it gains  5 temporary hit points and an  Action.

Name: Elixir of Cloud Giant Strength
Description: Strength increased to 27.

Name: Elixir of Darkvision
Description: Can see in the dark up to  12 m / 40 ft.

Name: Elixir of Heroism
Description: Affected entity is granted a  1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and  Saving throws until the next long rest.

Name: Elixir of Hill Giant Strength
Description: Strength increased to 21.

Name: Elixir of Peerless Focus
Description: Affected entity's ability to maintain its spells has increased. It has  Advantage to  Saving throws against being charmed and for maintaining  Concentration. Magic can't put it to  Sleep.

Name: Elixir of The Colossus
Description: Size is increased Weapons deal an additional  1d4 damage, and the affected entity has  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Carrying capacity is also increased by 25%.

Name: Elixir of Viciousness
Description: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

Name: Elixir of Vigilance
Description: Affected entity has a +5 bonus to initiative and can't be  Surprised. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

Name: Elven Elegance
Description: Noble elven arcana grants the affected entity an additional  10 m / 33 ft movement speed,  Superior Darkvision, and can't be  Charmed until its next Long Rest.

Name: Enchanted Security
Description: Intricate arcane lockmaking prevents  Knock spells from opening this safe.

Name: Encrusted with Frost
Description: Affected entity has  Disadvantage on Dexterity  Saving throws. When there are 7 or more turns remaining, the entity must succeed a DC 12  Constitution saving throw or take 1d4Cold and become  Frozen. On a successful save, it only takes half damage. Afterward, the frost sloughs away. Removed by  Burning.

Name: Encumbered
Description: Carrying too much weight. Movement Speed reduced by  3 m / 10 ft, and Jump distance is halved.

Name: Endless Rage
Description: Confers all the normal bonuses and resistances of the Rage variant of the Barbarian's chosen subclass, plus:Deal an additional 1d4Physical damage with weapon attacks (damage type inherited from equipped weapon) Suffer 1d4Psychic damage per turn  Rage does not end until the Barbarian uses the End Rage Bonus Action or becomes incapacitated.

Name: Enemy of Justice
Description: Wanted for killing a guard. Allied guards will attack on sight, but Disguise Self will fool them.

Name: Enhanced Armour Class
Description: Armour Class increased by 1.

Name: Enlarged
Description: Size is increased. Weapon attacks deal  1d4 more damage. Has  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws.

Name: Ensnared
Description: Cannot move and takes 1d6Piercing damage per turn. Attack rolls against the creature have  Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

Name: Entangled
Description: Cannot move. Attack rolls against the creature have  Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

Name: Enthralled
Description: Peripheral vision reduced. Will keep looking at the spellcaster.

Name: Entranced Murderer
Description: Affected entity has been entranced by the Farslayer. Defeating the Farslayer will break the trance and garner you victory.

Name: Entropic Ward
Description: Missed an attack on a warlock. The warlock has  Advantage on their next Attack roll against the affected entity.

Name: Enwebbed
Description: Cannot move. Attack rolls against the creature have  Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws are rolled with  Disadvantage.

Name: Ephemeral Whispers
Description: Tempted by Ethel's whispers. This creature must succeed a DC 13  Wisdom saving throw at the start of their turn or be inflicted with  Hag's Pawn.

Name: Eternally Bound
Immunity: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Cazador will not let this spawn die - it is Immune to all damage.

Name: Ether-Essence Slumber
Description: A deep, dream-ridden sleep has overcome the creature, induced by judicious ingesting of Ether. The creature cannot move or act. The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity  Saving throws. Attack rolls against the creature have  Advantage Removed by taking damage or being Shoved.

Name: Ethereal Escape
Description: As a  Reaction to receiving damage, the incubus has travelled to the Ethereal Plane and can't be damaged or targeted until it returns at the start of its next turn.

Name: Evasive Footwork
Description: Enemies have  Disadvantage on melee attacks against the affected entity.

Name: Ever Radiant
Description: Deals an additional 1d4Radiant.

Name: Executioner
Description: Spurred on by bloodlust. Next Attack roll will be a Critical Hit.

Name: Exhausted
Description: Lack of rest has left you exhausted. There are six levels of exhaustion, and each level is worse than the last. Completing a Long Rest reduces your exhaustion level by 1.

Name: Expeditious Retreat
Description: Dash available as a Bonus Action.

Name: Exploding Flumph
Description: This spirit will explode at the end of the turn. Each creature within  2 m / 7 ft must succeed a Dexterity  Saving throw or take 1d6Force.

Name: Explosion Imminent!
Description: The freezing sphere will explode, casting  Otiluke's Freezing Sphere.

Name: Explosive Hoard
Description: This mound of coins is primed to explode.

Name: Exposing Bite
Description: Creature is distracted. The next attack against the creature from within 2 m / 7 ft is guaranteed to be a critical hit.

Name: Extinguished
Description: This light was snuffed out.

Name: Extra Bonus Action
Description: Grants an additional  Bonus Action on this turn.

Name: Eyebite
Description: Entity can recast  Eyebite without expending a spell slot.

Name: Eyebite: Sickened
Description: Affected entity has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Checks

Name: Eyes of the Dark
Description: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of 25 m / 83 ft.

Name: Faerie Fire
Description: Shedding dim light. Incoming attacks have  Advantage. Cannot be Invisible.

Name: False Heart
Description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its False Heart by  Silencing itself.

Name: False Life
Description: Gain  7 temporary hit points plus 5 additional for each spell slot level above the first.

Name: Faltering Will
Description: Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws until Long Rest.

Name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
Description: Affected entity's fists are flickering with flame. Its melee attacks deal an additional 1d4Fire damage.

Name: Favoured Weapon
Description: This weapon has +1 bonus to damage and attack rolls.

Name: Fear Aura
Description: The affected creature can  Frighten nearby beasts and humanoids with its fey presence.

Name: Fearful
Description: Has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack rolls. It must run from the source of its fear and cannot take any additional actions. Targets can make a  Saving throw to shake off this effect if they end their turn out of sight from their source of fear.

Name: Feather Fall
Description: Rate of falling is slowed, granting Immunity to Falling damage.

Name: Feeble
Description: Deal only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength. At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Constitution  Saving throw to end this condition.

Name: Feigning Death
Resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Has sunk into a magical coma deep enough to imitate death Resistant to all damage except Psychic damage, and Disease and Poison no longer have any effect Removed when Helped

Name: Festering Frenzy
Description: This gnoll will become  Frenzied at the start of his next turn.

Name: Festering Spores
Description: While  Symbiotic Entity is active you can spread  Bibberbang Spores,  Timmask Spores, and  Haste Spores.

Name: Fetcher's Favour
Description: Equipped with  Mol's tricks of the trade, affected creatures can cast  Rays of Fire, reduce all Fire damage by 5 and gain an additional 1d4 to Charisma Checks and Saving Throws.

Name: Fetid Aura
Description: All nearby creatures fall victim to the ooze's Fetid Fumes and 1d6Acid per turn.

Name: Fetid Fumes
Description: 1d6 (1~6) Acid The fumes emanating from the Fetid Ooze eat away at the affected entity, so long as it stays within  2 m / 7 ft. 1d6Acid at the start of each round.

Name: Feverish
Description: Increasingly feverish.  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Strength. When the duration ends, make a DC 15  Constitution saving throw. Failing will inflict the condition  Filth Fever.

Name: Feywild Sparks
Description: While  Tides of Chaos is active, the affected entity will always trigger its  Wild Magic Surge when casting spells.

Name: Fiendish Obeisance
Description: Affected entity must obey the commands of the fiend directly controlling it.

Name: Fiendish Obeisance: Kneel
Description: Affected entity has been compelled to kneel by a fiend. It cannot move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving throws. Attacks against it have  Advantage if they're made within  3 m / 10 ft of the entity. The entity must spend half its movement speed to stand up.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Acid
Description: You have Resistance to Acid damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Bludgeoning
Description: You have Resistance to Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Cold
Description: You have Resistance to Cold damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Fire
Description: You have Resistance to Fire damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Force
Description: You have Resistance to Force damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Lightning
Description: You have Resistance to Lightning damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Necrotic
Description: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Piercing
Description: You have Resistance to Piercing damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Poison
Description: You have Resistance to Poison damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Psychic
Description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Radiant
Description: You have Resistance to Radiant damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Slashing
Description: You have Resistance to Slashing damage.

Name: Fiendish Resilience: Thunder
Description: You have Resistance to Thunder damage.

Name: Fiendish Vice
Description: Affected entity can call on diabolic arcana to cast  Thaumaturgy,  Hellish Rebuke,  Burning Hands, and  Flame Blade once each until the next Long Rest.

Name: Fierce Perilous Stakes
Vulnerability: Cold, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Affected entity's attacks deal an additional 15Psychic damage and heal 2d8hit points. The entity scores a Critical Hit when rolling a 15 or higher. The entity is Vulnerable to all damage.

Name: Fiery Brew
Description: Affected entity deals an additional 2d6Fire damage while infused with Thisobald's current brew.

Name: Filth Fever
Description: Crushed by fever.  Disadvantage on Attack rolls, and  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Strength. When the duration ends, make a DC 15  Constitution saving throw. Failing will re-inflict the Filth Fever condition.  Duration: 25 turns

Name: Fire Infusion
Description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d4Fire the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

Name: Fire Resistance
Description: You gain Resistance to Fire damage, and can no longer  Burn.

Name: Fire Resistance Aura
Description: The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to Fire damage.

Name: Fire Shield: Chill
Description: Wreathed in ice-cold flames. Sheds light in a 3m / 10ft radius. Has Resistance to Fire damage. Deals 2d8Cold damage to anyone who hits with a melee attack.

Name: Fire Shield: Warm
Description: Wreathed in scorching flames. Sheds light in a 3m / 10ft radius. Has Resistance to Cold damage. Deals 2d8Fire damage to anyone who hits with a melee attack.

Name: Firewine Belly
Skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
Description: Drunk on Firewine. Has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity Checks If the drunk entity is killed with Fire, a  Firewine Explosion occurs.

Name: Flame-Feeble
Description: Affected entity is Vulnerable to Fire damage.

Name: Flaming Aura
Description: Creature is standing within  1.5 m / 5 ft of a flaming sphere and will take 2d6Fire at the end of its turn. On a successful save, it will still take half damage.

Name: Flaming Sphere
Description: Enemies and objects within  1.5 m / 5 ft of the sphere at end of their turn take  2d6 (2~12) Fire  damage. On a successful save, it still takes half damage.

Name: Fleeting Protection
Description: If the affected entity is attacked with Radiant damage, Raphael's protection reflects twice that amount as Fire damage and this condition ends.

Name: Flesh Rot
Vulnerability: Cold, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Flesh is decaying.  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Charisma. Vulnerable to all damage. DC 15  Constitution saving throw to remove condition when the duration ends, otherwise it is reapplied.

Name: Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 1
Description: Affected entity cannot move as its body begins to petrify over the course of 3 turns. Attack rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

Name: Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 2
Description: Affected entity cannot move as its body progresses toward petrification. Attack rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

Name: Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 3
Description: Affected entity cannot move as its body enters the final bone-stiffening stages of petrification. Attack rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

Name: Flight
Description: Fly up to target position, up to  18 m / 60 ft each turn using your Movement Speed.

Name: Flying Strike
Description: Affected entity has flown this turn. Its next melee weapon attack deals an additional 1d4Psychic.

Name: Foolish Little Pup
Description: Shouldn't have done that, petal. Frightened.

Name: Force Conduit
Description: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage against the affected entity is reduced by 1 per turn remaining. If the entity takes damage while it has 5 or more turns remaining, it deals 1d4Force damage in a 6 m / 20 ft radius. Force Conduit has a maximum  Duration: 7 turns.

Name: Force Resistance
Description: Resistant to Force damage.

Name: Force Steadfast
Description: Affected entity can't be moved against its will.

Name: Forced Manoeuvre
Description: Movement speed increased by 4.5 m / 15 ft and doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

Name: Form of Artifice
Description: Your constructed form grants you  Advantage on Attack rolls and resistance to Lightning damage.

Name: Form of Dread
Description: The Ch'r'ai has 15 Temporary Hit Points and can't be  Frightened. Each time she attacks a foe, that foe can become  Frightened for 1 turn.

Name: Formless Slaughter
Description: This creature has a +1 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls while disguised or shapeshifted.

Name: Fox's Cunning
Description: Has  Advantage on Intelligence Checks.

Name: Fractured Psyche
Description: Creature's  Armour Class is reduced by 1.

Name: Fractured Psyche (Full-illithid)
Description: Your  Armour Class is reduced by 5 and you have a -5 penalty to  Saving throws.

Name: Freedom of Movement
Description: The affected creature's Movement Speed cannot be reduced by Difficult Terrain, spells or magical effects. The affected creature cannot be  Paralysed or  Restrained.

Name: Frenzied
Description: Deal an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has Resistance to physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.

Name: Frenzied Fury
Description: Overwhelmed with rage, the gnoll can attack three times per turn.

Name: Frenzied Spores
Description: Glut has increased hit points and Strength. It has access to more spore spells.

Name: Frenzied Strain
Description: Using  Frenzied Strike adds a stack of Frenzied Strain. The barbarian takes a -1 penalty on Attack Rolls for every stack. All stacks are removed when  Frenzy ends.

Name: Friends
Description: Has  Advantage on  Charisma checks directed at the target creature. In higher difficulty modes, the target might accuse you of enchanting them.

Name: Frightened
Description: The affected creature cannot move. Frightened creatures also have  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and Attack rolls.

Name: Frozen
Description: Affected entity is utterly enamelled in ice and is Incapacitated. If it is dealt Bludgeoning, Thunder, or Force damage, the ice shatters, ending the condition. Gains Vulnerability to Bludgeoning, Thunder, and Force damage. Gains Resistance to Fire damage. Gains immunity to  Burning and  Encrusted with Frost.

Name: Fugitive
Description: Recently escaped from prison. Guards will arrest this prisoner on sight.

Name: Fungal Resistance
Description: The hag has a +5 bonus to Saving Throws for each nearby Pearlspore Bell.

Name: Fungal Resurrection
Description: The hag will be resurrected by nearby Pearlspore Bells at the start of their next turn.

Name: Galerian Revelry
Description: Compelled to shuffle and dance. Affected entity can't move or take actions. Attack rolls against it have  Advantage, while its Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

Name: Galvanic Currents
Description: Blue lightning flits across the weapon's surface. Deals an additional 1d6Lightning.

Name: Gaping Wounds
Description: Attacks against this creature deal an additional 2Piercing damage. Removed by healing.

Name: Garrotted
Description: Affected entity is being strangled by a garrotte. It is Silenced and takes 3d6Bludgeoning damage per turn. Both the entity and the garrotter can't move until the condition ends. If the entity and the garrotter are forcibly moved more than  5 m / 17 ft apart, this condition ends.

Name: Garrotting
Description: Strangling a creature with a garrotte. Moving more than 5 m / 17 ft away from the creature will break the garrotte.

Name: Gaseous Form
Resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Transformed into a cloud of mist. Resistant to all damage. Has  Advantage on Constitution, Dexterity, and Strength  Saving throws. Becomes Tiny in size. Cannot attack, cast spells, or speak. The target's Strength and Dexterity scores are set to 10 while in this form.

Name: Gaseous Reflux
Description: Physical attacks have added gas to Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Roaring Belch.

Name: Gathering Drumbeat
Description: A goblin has sounded these war drums, calling reinforcements to battle. Will draw nearby goblins into combat. If used in the Goblin Camp, will turn the entire camp hostile as well. All  Temporarily Hostile enemies become permanently hostile.

Name: Ghastly Fume
Description: The affected entity's foul stench creates a pungent cloud that  Nauseates all creatures around it.

Name: Giant Form
Description: Affected entity's size is increased. Its weapon attacks deal an additional 1d6 damage. It gains  27 temporary hit points, and has  Advantage on Strength  Ability checks and  Saving throws.

Name: Giant's Rage
Description: Raging and increased in size. Deals an additional 2 damage (increased to 3 at level 9) with melee and improvised weapons, unarmed strikes, and 4 damage (increased to 6 at level 9) while throwing objects . Also has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws. Size is increased by one category. Cannot cast or concentrate on Spells.

Name: Gigantic Endurance
Description: Gained  27 temporary hit points.

Name: Githyanki Providence
Description: A mote of githyanki psionics allows the affected entity to cast  Misty Step,  Enhance Leap, and  Blur once each until its next Long Rest.

Name: Githyanki War Magic
Description: Can make a weapon attack using a bonus action.

Name: Githzerai Mind Barrier
Description: Having assimilated a splinter of githzerai knowledge, mental barriers have been erected in the affected entity's mind. It has  Advantage on Intelligence Saving Throws.

Name: Glimpse of Freedom
Description: Escaping certain death, the character is motivated to move  4.5 m / 15 ft quicker.

Name: Glutted Catacombs
Description: This area is filled with the bones of the dead. The spell  Animate Dead: Skeleton does not require a skeleton to raise the dead in this area.

Name: Gnawing Horde
Description: Ravenous Ghouls that fight alongside you.

Name: Gnomish Ingenuity
Description: Affected entity is Proficient in Sleight of Hand Checks and can cast  Knock until it takes a Long Rest.

Name: Goaded
Description: Must attack the goading creature, if possible.  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against targets other than the spellcaster.

Name: God of Ambition
Description: Mere mortals whisper petitions to the newly divine Gale Dekarios as The Once-Wizard, High Aspirant, The Lord of Zeal - but none have yet been granted an audience with the God of Ambition. Until tonight, that is.

Name: Gossamer Tomb
Description: This creature is entombed in  Infested spider silk, and cannot move or take actions. Unless the silk is removed with Acid or Fire damage, it will explode, dealing 8d10Poison to the entombed creature.

Name: Grappled (Tentacle)
Description: At the start of each turn, the target makes a  Strength saving throw to attempt to free themselves. On a failed save, they take 2d6Psychic.

Name: Grappled
Description: Affected entity is incapacitated and cannot be damaged while held within the grapple.  Help it to free it!

Name: Grappling
Description: Affected entity has  Grappled another creature. Cannot move while Grappling. Interrupted by receiving damage.

Name: Grasp Essence
Description: When you hit a creature with an unarmed attack, you can regain 10hit points or choose to gain  Advantage on Attack Rolls or Saving Throws before the end of your next turn.

Name: Grasping Arrow: Entangled
Description: Affected entity will take 2d6Slashing damage when it moves, and its movement speed is reduced by 3 m / 10 ft.

Name: Gravely Wounded
Description: This person cannot be healed or saved.

Name: Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack
Description: Can make a melee attack as a  Bonus Action.

Name: Greater Arcane Hunger
Description: The Netherese Orb in Gale's body is weakening him. He has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and all  Saving throws.

Name: Greater Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
Description: Has an additional  Level 2 Spell Slot.

Name: Greater Invisibility
Description: Entity has  Advantage on Attack rolls. Attack Rolls against it have  Disadvantage When interacting with items, casting spells, or attacking, the entity needs to succeed on a Stealth Check to maintain Invisibility. The Check becomes harder with each successful attempt.

Name: Greater Toughness
Description: This material is extremely strong. Only a hit that deals at least 50 damage can damage it.

Name: Green Bed Regeneration
Description: When starting your turn on Plant Growth Surface or  Vine Surface regain 1~4hit points hit points.

Name: Grieving
Description: The affected creature has  Advantage on Attack rolls but  Disadvantage on  Ability checks while processing the loss of something dear to it.

Name: Gripped by Kereska's Flame
Description: Affected entity has resistance to Fire damage. Its fire spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus. When it deals spell damage, it gains 2 turns of  Heat. While attuned to Kereska's flame, it can cast  Fireball at 3rd level and  Wall of Fire at 5th level once per short rest.

Name: Grotesque Distention
Description: Bloated beyond hope. Will explode at the slightest touch. Touching an entity affected with this condition will cause a blast of 8d6Poison damage in an  AoE: 3 m / 3 ft (Radius), form a Poison Cloud of the same size, and utterly destroy the entity.

Name: Guardian Wraiths
Immunity: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Affected entity is Immune to all damage. When this effect ends, the entity will be healed for 6d8hit points, unless it is ended by  Greater Restoration or  Remove Curse.

Name: Guidance
Description: Gains a  +1d4 bonus to  Ability checks.

Name: Guided Strike: Active
Description: You have a +10 bonus to your next Attack roll.

Name: Guiding Bolt
Description: The next Attack roll made against this creature has  Advantage.

Name: Haemorrhaged
Description: The target takes 1d6Piercing damage at end of turn.

Name: Hag Pregnancy
Description: The hag has eaten the child to transform her into a newborn hag. Killing the hag will lead to the child's death.

Name: Hag's Pawn
Description: Ethel has taken control. Condition lasts until mask is removed or spellcaster is dead.

Name: Hag's Trickery
Description: Is this Ethel - or an illusion?

Name: Half-Orcish Fury
Description: The next time the affected entity is  Downed, it instead drops to 1 hit point thanks to the relentless will roiling in its veins.

Name: Halfling Luck
Description: The luck of the smallfolk grants the affected entity  Advantage on Skill Checks until its next Long Rest.

Name: Hallucinating
Description: Creature is hallucinating. It has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks, wanders around uncontrollably, and can't take  Actions or reactions.

Name: Hamstrung
Description: Movement Speed reduced by 50%. Removed by healing.

Name: Hands Off - Petal
Skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
Description: Ethel disapproves, dearie.  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks. Take 2d4Psychic damage when condition is received.

Name: Happy
Description: Astarion's vampiric hunger has been temporarily sated. +1 to all Attack Rolls, Saving Throws, and most Ability Checks.

Name: Harm
Description: Affected entity's maximum Hit Points have been reduced by the damage inflicted by the Harm spell This condition is a Disease

Name: Harmonised
Description: Affected entity's melee weapon attacks deal additional damage equal to its Charisma Modifier (min.1).

Name: Harrowed
Description: The affected entity is psychically oppressed by a powerful ghost. It has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Wisdom  Saving throws.

Name: Haste Spores
Description: Target gains Advantage on Dexterity  Saving throws. Target's Movement Speed is doubled. Target gains an additional  Action.

Name: Hastened
Description: The affected creature acquires the following: Advantage on Dexterity  Saving throws An increase in Movement Speed of  9 m / 30 ft An additional  Action  When the condition ends, the affected creature becomes  Lethargic and is unable to move or take Actions for 1 turn.

Name: Haunted Approach
Description: This creature's Movement speed and jump distance is halved while within  3 m / 10 ft of a Cursed Skull

Name: Haunting Aura
Description: Nearby creatures are afflicted with  Phantasmal Force.

Name: Healing Incense
Description: Affected entity regains 1d4hit points at the start of the spellcaster's turn, as long as they remain within  10 m / 33 ft of them.

Name: Healing Incense Aura
Description: Applies  Healing Incense to affected entity and allies within  Range: 10 m / 30 ft, regaining 1d4hit points per turn.

Name: Healing Pearl
Description: At the start of its turn, this mushroom keeping Auntie Ethel alive regains all its hit points unless some effect prevents it from restorative healing.

Name: Healing Radiance
Description: Allies within 3m / 10ft will regain Proficiency bonus + Paladin level + Charisma modifierHealing at the start of the Paladin's next turn.

Name: Heart of Stone
Description: Gain Resistance to Poison until next Long Rest.

Name: Heartform Mapped
Description: The affected entity's  Violent,  Craven,  Jealous,  Melancholy,  Prying,  False, or  Wayward Heart has been mapped and punished by Viconia.

Name: Heartform Terror: Ceremorphosis
Description: Overcome with the fear they've turned into an illithid, the affected entity cannot move or take actions.

Name: Heartform Terror: Spider
Description: This creature has twisted its form into one of your fears.

Name: Heartform Terror: Wolf
Description: This Sharran knows your fears and has twisted its form into one of them.

Name: Heat
Description: Engulfed by a vengeful fire. Takes 1d4Fire damage each turn, but can use  Heat Convergence. Heat Convergence consumes all remaining turns of Heat to deal extra Fire damage on their next fire spell or attack. Heat has a maximum  Duration: 7 turns.

Name: Heat Convergence
Description: The next time the affected entity deals Fire damage, it deals an additional 1 for every turn of  Heat still affecting them.

Name: Heat Metal
Description: Heats up a metal weapon or armour on a creature with no save (weapon is automatically prioritized). Metal weapons are dropped if the creature holding it fails their initial  Saving throw. If the creature is touching the heated metal item, they receive  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks. Each subsequent turn, if the creature is still touching the metal, the spellcaster can use  Reapply Heat Metal to deal another 2d8Fire damage, forcing the creature to pass a Saving Throw again or drop the item (if it is a metal weapon).

Name: Heat Metal: Reapply Damage
Description: Creature can reapply the damage dealt by the heated metal.

Name: Heavily Encumbered
Description: Carrying far too much weight. Movement Speed heavily reduced, and you can no longer climb or Jump. You also have  Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls, as well as Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Saving Throws.

Name: Heavily Obscured
Description: Hiding in a Heavily Obscured area. Will go undetected unless they get too close to another creature.

Name: Hellfire Cambion
Description: This cambion's attacks deal Hellfire damage, ignoring Resistance and Immunity to Fire damage.

Name: Hellfire Curse
Description: Hellfire roiling within this creature gives it  Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution  Saving throws.

Name: Hellish Sphere
Description: Creature is standing within  3 m / 10 ft of a flaming sphere and will take 6d6Fire damage at the end of its turn. On a second save, it will still take half damage. Dexterity save

Name: Hellish Sphere (Aura)
Description: Enemies and objects within  3 m / 10 ft of the sphere at the end of their turn take 6d6Fire. On a successful save, they still take half damage.

Name: Her Voice: Commanding
Skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
Description: Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -1 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6Psychic damage at the end of its turn.

Name: Her Voice: the End of All
Skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
Description: Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -4 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6Psychic damage at the end of its turn.

Name: Her Voice: Transforming
Skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
Description: Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -2 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6Psychic damage at the end of its turn.

Name: Heroic
Description: Affected entity has gained  10 temporary hit points.

Name: Heroism
Description: Can't be  Frightened. Receive  5 temporary hit points per turn.

Name: Hexblade's Curse
Description: Cursed by a Hexblade warlock. The warlock who cursed this entity adds their proficiency bonus to damage rolls against them. The number they need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking this entity is also reduced by 1.

Name: Hexed Weapon
Description: The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it. The weapon's damage is magical and uses the warlock's Charisma modifier. When the warlock attacks with this weapon, there is a chance that  Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target.

Name: Hexed: Charisma
Description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Charisma Checks.

Name: Hexed: Constitution
Description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Constitution Checks.

Name: Hexed: Dexterity
Description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks.

Name: Hexed: Intelligence
Description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks.

Name: Hexed: Strength
Description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks.

Name: Hexed: Wisdom
Skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
Description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.

Name: Hide in Plain Sight
Description: Affected entity is invisible. It has  Advantage on Attack Rolls. It has a +10 bonus to Stealth Checks. Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity moves, attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

Name: Hideous Laughter
Description: Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on  Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if they're made within  3 m / 10 ft of the creature. At the end of its turn or when it takes damage, the entity can try to shake off the effect.

Name: Hiding
Description: Affected entity is invisible to enemies until it crosses their cone of sight. The entity has  Advantage on all Attack rolls.

Name: High Spirits
Description: The amulet's spirit lingers, making everything seem just a little more vibrant. Must succeed a Wisdom  Saving throw when using the amulet's power, or become  Hysterical.

Name: Hill Giant's Might
Description: The mountains quake! Strength increased to 21.

Name: Hoarding Energy
Resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Ansur is gathering energy while airborne and is Resistant to all damage.

Name: Hold Monster
Description: Affected entity can't Move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions. Attacks against the entity have  Advantage. Attacks against the entity are always Critical Hits if the attacker is within  Range: 3 m / 10 ft. Affected entity automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity  Saving throws. At the end of each turn, the affected entity makes a Wisdom  Saving throw. On a successful save, the condition is removed.

Name: Hold Person
Description: Affected entity can't Move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions. Attacks against the entity automatically succeed their Attack Roll. Attacks against the entity are always Critical Hits if the attacker is within  Range: 3 m / 10 ft. Affected entity automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity  Saving throws. At the end of each turn, the affected entity makes a Wisdom  Saving throw. On a successful save, the condition is removed.

Name: Holy Fire
Description: Takes 1~4Radiant damage per turn.

Name: Holy Rebuke
Description: Affected entity is protected by a vengeful aura. Attackers take 1d4Radiant damage when they hit the entity with a melee attack.

Name: Hoots' Hooch
Description: A new invention of the Sharess' Caress bartender Hoots - like being decked in the sobriety.

Name: Hoots' Hooch: Bad Breath
Description: Characters attacking you in melee become  Nauseous.

Name: Hoots' Hooch: Beast Tongue
Description: You're pretty sure you could speak to animals if you tried.

Name: Hoots' Hooch: Blackout
Description: Character is unconscious.

Name: Hoots' Hooch: Gifted
Description: You can read minds, but become Vulnerable to Psychic damage.

Name: Hoots' Hooch: Photosensitivity
Description: Become  Blind in direct sunlight but gain  Superior Darkvision.

Name: Hoots' Hooch: Size Instability
Description: Reduce and  Enlarge each turn.

Name: Hoots' Hooch: Stoned
Description: Temporarily  Petrified - perhaps with lingering side-effects.

Name: Horde Breaker
Description: Creature is open to a follow-up attack.

Name: Hound's Omen
Description: A dark omen that can be of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. When damage of that type is dealt to the affected entity, the owner of the hound regains 1  Sorcery Point.

Name: Houndmaster's Prey
Description: When a Houndmaster's dog (Zina, Gordis, Rocky) hits the target, it gains  Prey Essence, gaining 30 Temporary Hit Points.

Name: Human Versatility
Description: Mundane pluckiness grants the affected entity Proficiency in all skills until the next Long Rest due to the wily resourcefulness now bubbling within it.

Name: Hunger of Hadar
Description: 2d6 (2~12) Cold   2d6 (2~12) Acid DC 12  Dexterity saving throwStanding near a portal to the dark between the stars, infested with unknown horrors. Takes 2d6Cold damage at the start of their turn, and possibly 2d6Acid damage at the end of their turn, as long as they are in the area They are  Blinded and the area is  Difficult Terrain.

Name: Hunger of Hadar (Aura)
Description: A sphere of cold blackness, teeming with unknown horrors. Creatures starting their turn in the area take 2d6Cold. Creatures ending their turn in the area possibly take 2d6Acid. The area is  Difficult Terrain, and creatures within are  Blinded.

Name: Hungover
Skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Persuasion, Performance, Intimidation, Deception
Description: You have  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma Checks. You tell yourself 'I'm never drinking again'. You're a liar.

Name: Hunt Completed
Description: Can use a bonus action to reapply Hunter's Mark to another target.

Name: Hunted
Description: Yurgir can interrupt this creature's attacks and spells once per round with a  Blinding Ambush while it is Hunted.

Name: Hunter's Mark Quarry
Description: Affected entity suffers an additional 1d6Weapon damage if the spellcaster hits it with a weapon attack.

Name: Hypnotic Gaze
Description: Can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions. Spellcaster has  Advantage on Ability Checks in dialogue. Removed upon taking damage. Duration can be extended with  Maintain Hypnotic Gaze

Name: Hypnotised
Description: Can't Move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions. Removed by taking damage, being Shoved, or Helped.

Name: Hysterical
Description: Knocked Prone out of sheer elation. Sides splitting, lungs gasping for air - you're enjoying yourself, aren't you?

Name: Icy Cloud
Description: A sheet of frigid air dealing 10d6Cold to all that walk through it. Affected entities can make a DC 16  Constitution saving throw to take half damage instead.

Name: Idyllic Aura
Description: Grants Silvanus' Blessing to creatures within range.

Name: Impaled
Description: A ghoul's spike prevents this creature from moving.

Name: Impenetrable slumber
Description: This individual is under the influence of copious sleeping draughts. It is impossible to wake them.

Name: Improved Bardic Inspiration
Description: Can use  Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d12 bonus to the next Attack roll,  Ability check, or  Saving throw. Grants:  Improved Bardic Inspiration: Attack Roll or Ability Check (Toggleable passive feature): Add a +1d12 bonus to your next Attack roll or Ability Check.  Improved Bardic Inspiration: Saving Throw (Toggleable passive feature): Add a +1d12 bonus to your next  Saving throw.  Bardic Defence (Reaction): +1d6 bonus to the next  Saving throw.  Bardic Attack (Reaction): +1d6 bonus to the next Attack roll.

Name: In Surgery
Description: Unable to move while strapped onto the operating gurney.

Name: Incapacitated
Description: Cannot take Actions or Reactions. Lose  Concentration, if maintaining a Concentration spell.

Name: Inciting Howl
Description: Movement Speed increased by  3 m / 10 ft.

Name: Incubating
Description: Skeletal involucre will explode on its next turn, dealing 6~27Necrotic damage and birthing a necromite.

Name: Incubus Charmed
Description: You are charmed by a devil and must support it in battle. You can make another Saving Throw against this effect after taking damage.

Name: Induced Rage
Description: The mix of chemicals has thrown the Owlbear into a fit of rage. It is stronger, jumps further, gains a multiattack, and can rupture the earth. The Owlbear receives 4d8Healing every turn if below  105 hit points. The Owlbear has +2 Strength.

Name: Inevitable Resolve
Description: Any effect controlling or incapacitating this creature will cease at the end of its next turn.

Name: Infected
Description: Has  Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws, and Constitution is reduced by 1.

Name: Infectious Greed
Description: The affected entity's attacks deal an additional 6d6Piercing damage in the presence of Helsik. Additionally, it has  Advantage on Attack rolls against targets marked by  Promise of Wealth.

Name: Infernal Binding
Immunity: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Hope is Immune to all damage while imprisoned in the House of Hope.

Name: Infernal Burning
Description: Takes 1d4Fire damage per turn. CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet. The entity affected cannot regain Hit Points

Name: Infernal Fury
Description: The hatred and pain of a captured soul fuels  Karlach's infernal machine. Her weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4Fire damage when she is  Raging or when her Hit Points drop below 25%.

Name: Infernal Legion
Description: You are one, you are legion, without personality or individuality - born only to fight. When within 20m / 67ft of another creature wearing a merregon's mask, Strength increases by 1 and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma decrease by 1 per nearby mask.

Name: Infernal Stun
Description: This creature cannot move or act, and Raphael can  Soul Drain it at will.

Name: Infested
Description: Crawling with tiny spiders that deal 1d4 Piercing damage and 1d4 Poison damage each turn. When hit with a melee attack, the infestation spreads to the attacker. Upon death, the infestation spreads to all nearby creatures. Removed by Fire or Acid damage. Doesn't harm ettercaps or spiders. At the start of your turn, you can make a new Saving Throw to try and remove the infection.

Name: Infiltration Expertise
Description: Appearance is entirely changed.

Name: Ingested Poisoned Beer
Description: Beer mixed with a deadly toxin courses through the character's veins, slowly killing it. Affected entity takes 1d6+6Poison damage per turn, for 10 turns.

Name: Inoculated: Basic Poison
Description: You succeeded on a  Saving throw against  Basic Poison and can't be affected by it.

Name: Inoculated: Crawler Mucus
Description: You succeeded on a  Saving throw against  Crawler Mucus and can't be affected by it.

Name: Inoculated: Drow Poison
Description: You succeeded on a  Saving throw against  Drow Poison and can't be affected by it.

Name: Inoculated: Malice
Description: You succeeded on a  Saving throw against Malice and can't be affected by it.

Name: Inquisitor's Might
Description: Affected character's weapon attacks deal an additional + Charisma Ability Score Modifier Radiant damage. Affected character's weapon attacks can  Daze enemies for 1 turn.

Name: Insanity's Kiss
Description: Hostile to all other creatures for the condition's duration.

Name: Insect Plague
Description: Movement speed halved.  Disadvantage on Perception Checks. Affected entity takes 4d10Piercing damage per turn. Affected entity can make a  Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC to take half damage instead.

Name: Insect Plague (Aura)
Description: Swarming, biting locusts fill the air. They deal 4d10Piercing per turn, make the area  Difficult Terrain, and impose  Disadvantage on Perception Checks.

Name: Inspiring Resolve
Description: Affected entity has been fortified by courageous words, granting it  temporary hit points.

Name: Instinctive Charm: Unaffected
Description: Cannot be affected by  Instinctive Charm until after a Long Rest.

Name: Instrument of Loss: Bonesaw
Description: The Surgeon can use its implement to  Bonesaw a patient.

Name: Instrument of Loss: Leech
Description: The Surgeon can use its implement to  Leech a patient.

Name: Instrument of Loss: Syringe
Description: The Surgeon can use its implement to  Inject a patient.

Name: Instrument of Loss: Trepan
Description: The Surgeon can use its implement to  Trepan a patient.

Name: Invigorated Thrall
Description: Creatures created by Invigorating Flame will gain additional hit points based on summoner's wizard level and additional damage based on summoner's profiency bonus.

Name: Invigorating Fanaticism
Description: An unshakeable belief in its divine grants this creature Resistance to all physical damage and attacks that possibly  Bleed targets.

Name: Invisible
Description: Has  Advantage on Attack rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, interacts with an object, takes an action or bonus action, or is damaged.

Name: Invisible Weapon
Description: Affected entity can't be disarmed. It has  Advantage on Attack rolls. It scores a critical hit when rolling a 19.

Name: Invulnerable
Immunity: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Immune to all damage Can still be afflicted with status effects

Name: Ironwood Harmony
Description: Deals an additional 1d4Bludgeoning while imbued with the druidic magic of  Shillelagh.

Name: Jealous Heart
Description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its Jealous Heart by  Helping an ally.

Name: Jolted
Description: Takes 1d4Lightning damage each turn and can't take  Reactions. Removed upon leaving the Lightning Aura.

Name: Jump
Description: Jump distance is tripled.

Name: Just Look At Those Cheekbones!
Description: Gazing upon this depiction of themselves will  bless the owner of this statue once per Long Rest.

Name: Pushed*
Description: Knocks back the target.

Name: Knocked Out (Temporary)
Description: The affected entity which was  Temporarily Hostile before cannot move or take actions, bonus actions or reactions. The affected entity regains consciousness after a Long Rest.

Name: Knocked Out
Description: The affected entity which was permanently hostile before cannot move or take actions, bonus actions or reactions. The affected entity disappears permanently after a Long Rest.

Name: Knowledge of the Ages: Charisma
Description: Has Proficiency in  Deception,  Intimidation,  Performance,  Persuasion.

Name: Knowledge of the Ages: Dexterity
Description: Has Proficiency in  Acrobatics,  Sleight of Hand, and  Stealth.

Name: Knowledge of the Ages: Intelligence
Description: Has Proficiency in  Arcana,  History,  Investigation,  Nature, and  Religion.

Name: Knowledge of the Ages: Strength
Description: Has Proficiency in  Athletics.

Name: Knowledge of the Ages: Wisdom
Skill Proficiency: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
Description: Has Proficiency in  Animal Handling,  Insight,  Medicine,  Perception, and  Survival.

Name: Lair Magic
Description: When in their lair, the hag and her doubles have  Magic Resistance

Name: Lathander's Light
Description: Sheds holy light in a  6 m / 20 ft radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are  Blinded, unless they succeed a  Constitution saving throw.

Name: Leadership
Description: Bolstered with supernatural resolve. Attacks deal an additional 1d4Force.

Name: Leadership Aura
Description: Allied creatures within  6 m / 20 ft deal an additional 1d4Force on their attacks. Non-branded creatures within  6 m / 20 ft are marked as the  Absolute's Enemies.T These effects will end if Dror Ragzlin is incapacitated.

Name: Legendary Action: Adamantine Reverberation
Description: When struck, Grym's adamantine form  Reverberates, doubling its movement and granting it 10 temporary hit points. Losing these temporary hit points triggers a shockwave that knocks targets back 4m and deals 4~32 Thunder damage.

Name: Legendary Action: Beguiling Rebuke
Description: Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately  Beguile a hostile creature and its allies after being attacked.

Name: Legendary Action: Bhaal's Edict
Description: If Orin does not use a Legendary Action this turn, the Dread Lord places a creature under Bhaal's Edict.

Name: Legendary Action: Blinding Ambush
Description: Once per round, Yurgir can strike a  Hunted creature when it attempts to attack or cast a spell, dealing 5d10 Radiant damage and possibly  Blinding the target.

Name: Legendary Action: Call Consort
Description: When attacked, the Owlbear can summon her mate to defend her.

Name: Legendary Action: Devoted Galvanism
Description: Once per round when an enemy targets their ally with an ability, Dror Ragzlin can use a Legendary Action to  Galvanise Absolutists within  5 m / 17 ft, granting them  Action Surge.

Name: Legendary Action: Draconic Fury
Description: This great drake will use its  Fire Breath on the next creature that attacks it.

Name: Legendary Action: Draconic Wrath
Description: This great drake will use its  Lightning Breath on the next creature that attacks it.

Name: Legendary Action: Fanatic Retaliation
Description: When an enemy kills a  Spindleweb Fanatic, Kar'niss will immediately  Retaliate against the attacker.

Name: Legendary Action: Gaze of the Dead
Description: Myrkul's Apostle will use  Gaze of the Dead on the first creature that strikes it each round in combat.

Name: Legendary Action: Gossamer Tomb
Description: Once per round if her offspring is attacked, this creature will try to encase the attacker in a Gossamer Tomb.

Name: Legendary Action: Grasping Appendage
Description: Once per round, Malus Thorm can spend a Legendary Action to use  Grasping Appendage.

Name: Legendary Action: Heartwrench
Description: Viconia can rend a target with a psychic barrage dealing 10d12Psychic after she or an ally is struck by a  Heartform Mapped creature.

Name: Legendary Action: Hordestrike
Description: Ketheric can  Hordestrike a foe when it is attacked by a minion under  Deadly Orders

Name: Legendary Action: Leaping Static
Description: Bernard can fire Leaping Static at the first foe that attacks it each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Murderous Retort
Description: Orin can immediately strike back at her attacker. If  Deathbringer's Legacy is active, she uses  Deathbringer's Assault (Orin) instead. Sarevok can immediately strike back at his attacker. If Deathbringer's Legacy is active, he uses  Deathbringer's Assault instead.

Name: Legendary Action: Ocular Nightmare
Description: After accumulating five  Paranoid Dreams, the Spectator will spend a Legendary Action to cast  Ocular Nightmare when it is next struck.

Name: Legendary Action: Overflowing Brew
Description: When Thisobald Thorm's brew changes, it can overflow, dealing 3d6 of the corresponding damage type and empowering his allies.

Name: Legendary Action: Psionic Visage
Description: Nere can immediately cast  Psionic Visage on himself when attacked.

Name: Legendary Action: Ptarian Dogma
Description: Once per round, after being hit, Ptaris can spend a Legendary Action to surround his attacker in  Ptarian Pacifism.

Name: Legendary Action: Sanctuary of Loss
Description: After an ally is struck, Viconia can apply  Sanctuary of Loss to them, shielding them from further attacks. This protection will wane when the protected creature attacks.

Name: Legendary Action: Sanguine Lash
Description: Orin can use  Sanguine Lash after being attacked. If Orin does not use her Legendary Action in a round,  Bhaal's Edict is placed on a creature.

Name: Legendary Action: Shredding Scales
Description: While it has  Diamond Scales, the Bulette can use  Shredding Scales immediately after being hit for the first time in a round.

Name: Legendary Action: Soul Ascension
Description: Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately cast  Soul Ascension when he or his allies are attacked.

Name: Legendary Action: Soul Sacrifice
Description: When a humanoid dies, the Ch'r'ai can  Sacrifice its soul to Vlaakith in return for great power. Once 3 souls have been sacrificed, the Ch'r'ai takes on  Vlaakith's Undying Aspect.

Name: Legendary Action: Spectral Aspect
Description: Balthazar can adopt his  Spectral Aspect after being struck.

Name: Legendary Action: Sublimation
Description: When she loses a piece of armour, Gerringothe Thorm can try to  Sublimate her foes - turning them into  gold.

Name: Legendary Action: The Dead Wastes
Description: When a creature dies, Balthazar can create a necrotic miasma where it fell that heals Undead 4~24 hit points and deals 4~24 Necrotic damage to living creatures at the start of their turns.

Name: Legendary Action: Torrential Undeath
Description: Once per turn upon being hit, Mystic Carrion can use  Torrential Undeath.

Name: Legendary Action: Tu'narath's Embrace
Description: Paladin Har'rak can use a Legendary Action to cast  Tu'narath's Embrace on an ally to prevent an Incapacitating Condition.

Name: Legendary Action: Tyrannical Branding
Description: Immediately after being struck, Gortash can  Brand his attacker.

Name: Legendary Action: Vampiric Swarm
Description: Cazador can call forth a  Swarm of Vampire Bats to attack an enemy who steps within  6 m / 20 ft of him.

Name: Legendary Action: Vengeful Playmate
Description: Once per round when one of Oliver's summoned shadows is destroyed, he can immediately envelop the nearby area in  The Wasting Quiet.

Name: Legendary Action: Wail of Loss
Description: After being attacked, once per round, Malus Thorm can make every assistant cast  Wail of Loss simultaneously.

Name: Legendary Action: Weird Magic Surge
Description: Auntie Ethel can use her Weird Magic Surge immediately after a spell is cast. A higher level spell will produce more illusory duplicates.

Name: Legendary Action: Wretched Growth
Description: If a creature ends its turn within  5 m / 17 ft of the Shambling Mound, it will take 3d10Necrotic and Shadow-Cursed Vines will grow at its feet, possibly  Entangling it.

Name: Legendary Actions Available
Description: Raphael has 1-4 use(s) of his Legendary Action remaining this round.

Name: Legendary Resistance
Description: Affected entity has a +10 bonus to its next  Saving throw. This can be used 3 times.

Name: Legendary Resistance: Crowd Control
Description: You have a +10 bonus to your next  Saving throw affecting multiple targets.

Name: Legendary Resistance: Incapacitation
Description: You have a +10 bonus to your next Saving Throw against an incapacitating condition. You can use this 3 times.

Name: Legions of Bone (Aura)
Description: If a character dies within  12 m / 40 ft of Ketheric in combat, a Skeletal Involucre will rise where they fell.

Name: Legions of Bone
Description: A Skeletal Involucre will rise near this creature if it dies within  12 m / 40 ft of Ketheric.

Name: Lethal Concealment
Description: Deal an additional 1d6Necrotic while  Hidden.

Name: Lethargic
Description: Consumed by exhaustion in the aftermath of  Haste. Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions.

Name: Levitating
Description: The affected entity is suspended in the air.

Name: Liberated Spellcasting
Description: You can cast a level 1 spell without spending a spell slot.

Name: Lieges of the Underdark Blessing
Description: Gains a  +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and  Saving throws.

Name: Life Drain
Description: Hit point maximum reduced by 2d8. Creature will die if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

Name: Life Essence
Description: Affected entity has absorbed a creature's essence. It can use that essence to cast any Necromancy spell without consuming a spell slot.

Name: Life Essence Active
Description: Affected entity next Necromancy spell can be cast without consuming a spell slot.

Name: Life of the Party
Description: Gain +Wisdom modifier bonus to Attack rolls against  Drunk targets.

Name: Light
Description: This object has an aura of light with a radius of  7.5 m / 25 ft.

Name: Lightly Obscured
Description: Hiding in a Lightly Obscured area. Has to make a Stealth check when caught.

Name: Lightning Aura
Description: Jolts nearby enemies.

Name: Lightning Blast
Description: Your next Lightning spell or cantrip deals additional Lightning damage equal to your remaining Lightning Charges. On hit, all of your LIghtning Charges are consumed.

Name: Lightning Charges
Description: Lightning courses through you. You have +1 to Attack Rolls and deal an additional 1Lightning damage. If you gain 5 charges, they are consumed the next time you deal damage, and you deal an additional 1d8Lightning damage. You lose 1 charge per turn.

Name: Lightning Infusion
Description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d4Lightning the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

Description: Silenced and held in place by a Profane Womb.

Name: Profoundly Intoxicated
Skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Persuasion, Performance, Intimidation, Deception
Description: Thisobald is on the verge of passing out from his heavy drinking. He has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity Checks, and his hallucinations continue.

Description: This magical projection cannot be targeted or attacked.

Description: Affected entity has been marked as wealthy by a follower of Mammon. Creatures with Infectious Greed have Advantage on Attack Rolls against it.

Name: Prone
Description: The affected creature cannot move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on  Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if made within  3 m / 10 ft of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up.A character with the Athlete feat spends only  1.5 m / 5 ft of Movement Speed to stand up.

Description: Deal at least 1Bludgeoning to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

Name: Prophecy: Delivering Alms

Name: Prophecy: Evocative

Description: Deal at least 1Acid to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

Description: Dealing the killing blow to an enemy will result in a new a Portent Die after taking a short rest.

Description: Deal at least 1Lightning to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

Description: Casting an Enchantment spell will result in a new Portent Die.

Name: Prophecy: Thunderous Applause
Description: Deal at least 1Thunder to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

Description: Deal at least 1Poison to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
