Description: Learning from or using a Spell Scroll will result in a new Portent Die.

Name: Protection from Energy: Acid
Description: Has Resistance to Acid damage

Name: Protection from Energy: Cold
Description: Has Resistance to Cold damage

Name: Protection from Energy: Fire
Description: Has resistance to Fire damage

Name: Protection from Energy: Lightning
Description: Has Resistance to Lightning damage

Name: Protection from Energy: Thunder
Description: Has Resistance to Thunder damage

Name: Protection from Evil and Good
Description: The target is protected against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead. These creatures have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against the target, and the target can't be Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by them.

Name: Protection from Poison
Description: All previous Poisonous effects afflicting the target are neutralized Target gains  Advantage on  Saving throws against being Poisoned Target gains Resistance to Poison damage

Name: Prowling
Description: Stalking its prey. While  Invisible, the affected entity's next attack deals additional 1d8 damage.

Name: Prying Heart
Description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its Prying Heart by  Poisoning itself.

Name: Psionic Drain
Description: Your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores are reduced by 2 while Ptaris drains your mind to form a Mental Image. If any ability score reaches 0, you die. Destroying the Mental Image releases the psionic energy and ends this effect.

Name: Psionic Enrichment
Description: After using a tadpole power, affected entity gains  Advantage on all attacks for 3 rounds.

Name: Psionic Visages
Description: Affected entity is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage while a Psionic Visage stands. When the caster is struck, a visage will shatter, striking the attacker directly with 2d6Psychic damage.

Name: Psionic Ward
Description: Affected entity has a +5 bonus to  Saving throws and can't be  Frightened while within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

Name: Psionic Ward Aura
Description: The gish and allies within  3 m / 10 ft have a +5 bonus to Saving Throws and can't be  Frightened.

Name: Psionic Weakening
Description: Affected entity has  Disadvantage on Constitution, Wisdom and Intelligence  Saving throws. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

Name: Psychic Rend
Skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
Description: Mentally in shambles. Has Disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and Saving Throws.

Name: Psychic Resistance
Description: Resistant to Psychic damage.

Name: Psychically Dominated
Description: This dragon is being controlled by the deep, twisting grasp of the Netherbrain's psychic might.

Name: Ptarian Pacifism
Description: Affected entity's Strength, Dexterity and Constitution scores have been reduced by 4. It and nearby allies are  Pacified. Unless the  50 temporary hit points granted by this effect are removed, when the effect ends, one of Ptaris' Mental Image will appear.

Name: Punish Divinity
Description: When hit with Radiant damage, Raphael can use a reaction to stun the attacker, leaving the impudent creature  Soul Wrenched

Name: Purple Worm Toxin
Description: Affected entity takes 1d10Poison damage at the end of its next turn.

Name: Pursuit Protocol
Description: You attacked a Steel Watcher. The Steel Watch are searching for you across the city.

Name: Qua'nith: Alert Active
Description: Voss's psionic detector has warned you of an imminent githyanki attack. You gain a +5 bonus to your initiative check and have Advantage on your next Attack Roll.

Name: Quickening Incantation
Description: You can cast Illusion and Enchantment Spells as a bonus action.

Name: Quickly Ticking Mine
Description: This grenade will explode on the end of its turn!

Name: Quickspell Flinger
Description: Cantrips that cost an  Action cost a  Bonus Action instead.

Name: Radiant Resistance
Description: Resistant to Radiant damage.

Name: Radiant Retort
Description: Whenever you take Radiant damage, reflect it back at your attacker twofold as Force damage.

Name: Radiating Orb
Description: Affected entity has -1 to Attack Rolls per remaining turn. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it. Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity makes an attack.

Name: Rage
Description: Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, unarmed strikes, and while throwing objects. Has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on Spells.

Name: Rage (Boar)
Description: Deals an additional 2 + 1d4Slashing[See Notes] damage with melee attacks. Is  Enlarged[See Notes]. Has Resistance to physical damage, and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws. Can use  Frenzied Strike (Boar). Rage ends early if the boar didn't attack an enemy or take damage since its last turn.

Name: Rage Impeded
Description: Weighed down by Heavy Armour. Until the armour is removed, Raging won't grant extra damage, resistance to physical damage, or  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws.

Name: Rage: Bear Heart
Resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Deals an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has resistance to all damage except Psychic damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells. Rage ends early if the barbarian didn't attack an enemy or take damage since their last turn.

Name: Rage: Eagle Heart
Description: Can use  Dash as a  Bonus Action, and foes have  Disadvantage on  Opportunity Attacks. Deals an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.

Name: Rage: Elk Heart
Description: Movement speed increased by  4.5 m / 15 ft and can use  Primal Stampede. Deals an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.

Name: Rage: Tiger Heart
Description: Jump distance increased by  4.5 m / 15 ft and can use  Tiger's Bloodlust. Deals an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.

Name: Rage: Wolf Heart
Description: Can use  Inciting Howl and allies have  Advantage on melee Attack rolls against enemies within  2 m / 7 ft. Deals an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.

Name: Rage: Wolf Heart's Prey
Description: Standing near a Raging Wolf Heart barbarian. The barbarian's allies have  Advantage on melee Attack rolls against this creature.

Name: Raging Vortex
Description: Affected entity is  Silenced and is being dealt 2d8Bludgeoning damage per turn while remaining in the vortex.

Name: Rallied
Description: Granted  8 temporary hit points by a friendly combatant's rallying cry.

Name: Rallied (Endgame)
Description: The galvanising word and will of Duke Ravengard runs hot through your veins - granting you 30 temporary hit points.

Name: Rampage
Description: When a gnoll Downs a creature with a melee attack on its turn, it regains 1 bonus action and half of its movement speed.

Name: Rampart Aura
Description: All entities with or in this aura have their movement speed halved.

Name: Rapport Spores
Description: Affected creatures can communicate telepathically with one another. Does not have a mechanical effect.

Name: Rapture
Description: Has a +1d6 bonus to Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, and Saving Throws. Until next long rest.

Name: Ray of Frost
Description: Movement Speed is reduced by  3 m / 10 ft.

Name: Reactive Restoration
Description: When  Blinded,  Paralysed, or  Poisoned, the affected entity is automatically  Restored.

Name: Ready to Parry
Description: The Githyanki stands ready to parry the next weapon attack, reducing its incoming damage by 10. The Githyanki can parry an attack as long as they have a  Reaction, they wield a greatsword, and they aren't  Blinded,  Incapacitated or  Restrained.

Name: Ready to Parry (Supreme)
Description: The Githyanki stands ready to parry the next weapon attack, reducing its incoming damage by 20. The Githyanki can parry an attack as long as they have a  Reaction, they wield a greatsword, and they aren't  Blinded,  Incapacitated or  Restrained.

Name: Reaper's Reward
Description: Consumed a necromite's soul and gained the ability to cast  Finger of Death

Name: Reapply Hex
Description: Can cast Hex without expending a new spell slot.

Name: Recast Speak with Dead
Description: Can recast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.

Name: Recharging
Description: This device cannot fire this turn.

Name: Reckless Attack
Description: You have  Advantage on Attack Rolls, but enemies also have Advantage on Attack Rolls against you.

Name: Reckless Roar
Description: Creature has  Advantage on Attack Rolls, but its attackers also have Advantage on Attack Rolls against the creature

Name: Reckless Warcry
Description: Strength is increased by 3.

Name: Reconfigured: Undead
Description: The foulest stench is in the air...

Name: Recovering
Description: Thisobald has had enough of his own concoctions - for now. Soon the numbness will set in once more, and the cycle will start all over again.

Name: Reduced
Description: Size is reduced. Weapon attacks deal  1d4 less damage. Has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws. Carrying Capacity is reduced by 25%

Name: Reduced (Duergar)
Description: Size is reduced. Has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws. Attacks deal  1d4 less damage.

Name: Reeling
Description: Recovering from receiving a terrible blow or hitting a strong metal. Has a -1 penalty to Attack Rolls for every turn remaining. Reeling has a maximum  Duration: 10 turns.

Name: Reflective Mucus
Description: Reflects the first projectile flying towards it back at the attacker, after which the mucus is removed.

Name: Reflective Shell
Description: Projectiles targeted at this creature are reflected back to their point of origin.

Name: Reflectoguard Active
Description: Any projectile fired at this character is sent back to where it came from.

Name: Refreshed
Description: Hit Point maximum increased by 10 until the next Long Rest. Turns into  Nauseated after a Long Rest.

Name: Regeneration
Description: The Wood Woad regains 10hit points if it walks through a vine surface, unless it recently took Fire damage.

Name: Rejuvenating Miasma
Description: Animate Dead doesn't require a corpse in this area due to a lingering necrotic stench.

Name: Relentless Avenger
Description: You have a  4.5 m / 15 ft bonus to your Movement Speed

Name: Rended Flesh
Description: Affected entity can't be healed and can't gain Temporary Hit Points.

Name: Repair Matrix
Description: At the start of its turn, restorative servos heal this Steel Watcher for 3d8hit points.

Name: Resistance
Description: Gains a  +1d4 bonus to  Saving throws.

Name: Resistant to Acid Damage
Description: Acid damage against this entity is halved.

Name: Resistant to Cold Damage
Description: Cold damage against this entity is halved.

Name: Resistant to Fire Damage
Description: Fire damage against this entity is halved.

Name: Resistant to Lightning Damage
Description: Lightning damage against this entity is halved.

Name: Resistant to Necrotic Damage
Description: Necrotic damage against this entity is halved.

Name: Resistant to Poison Damage
Description: Poison damage against this entity is halved.

Name: Resistant to Radiant Damage
Description: Radiant damage against this entity is halved.

Name: Resisted the Song
Description: The affected entity succeeded a  Saving throw against the harpy's  Luring Song and is immune to the effects for 2 turns.

Name: Resonating Ki
Description: The ki within the affected entity is resonating with a monk's. The monk can use  Ki Resonation: Blast to make it explode.

Name: Restrained
Description: Cannot move. Attack rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack rolls and  Dexterity saving throws have  Disadvantage

Name: Retributive Justice
Description: This Echo of Bhaal is drawing on new, terrible powers to avenge Sarevok's death.

Name: Revealed
Description: Affected entity lost its  Invisibility due to the effects of  See Invisibility.

Name: Reverberation
Description: Affected entity has a -1 penalty to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution  Saving throws per remaining turn. When the entity has 5 or more turns of Reverberation, it takes 1d4Thunder damage and must succeed a DC 10  Constitution saving throw or fall  Prone. The condition is removed afterward. Creatures Immune to Thunder damage can't receive Reverberation.

Name: Revitalising Gore
Description: Affected entity is drenched in its enemies' blood. It regains 2d6hit points per turn. At level 10, the healing is increased to 4d6hit points per turn.

Name: Righteous Clarity
Description: Has a +proficiency bonus to Attack rolls.

Name: Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill
Description: As part of the challenge to enter the temple, the Farslayer has begun chanting. It can cast  Bhaal's Power Word Kill once its profane ritual ends. Exiting the Farslayer's chanting range of 55 m / 183 ft makes its enemies invulnerable to the effect. Slaying the Farslayer stops the ritual and wins the conflict.

Name: Ritual Component
Description: Astarion is Incapacitated as part of a profane ritual until Helped.

Name: Ritual Drain: Astarion
Description: Has an additional bonus action after draining Astarion's life force. This effect can only apply once per round.

Name: Ritual Drain: Violet
Description: The creature has an additional +5 to its Armour Class after absorbing Violet's strength.

Name: Ritual Drain: Yousen
Description: The creature gains 3d8hit points every turn while drawing on Yousen's vitality.

Name: Ritual Sources
Description: For each ritual source, your movement increases by  1 m / 3 ft, you receive  10 temporary hit pointss and your attacks and spells deal an additional 1d10Necrotic damage, after draining a vampire spawn's life force.

Name: Roiling Hellfire
Description: 6d6 (6~36) Fire Flames from the heart of Avernus engulf this entity, inflicting 6d6Fire damage per turn.

Name: Rotten Reflux
Description: Necrotic damage has spoiled Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Rotting Regurgitation.

Name: Rotting
Description: Open wound is starting to rot.  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Charisma. DC 15  Constitution saving throw to remove condition when the condition expires from duration. Failure will lead to you gaining  Flesh Rot.

Name: Rumbling with Kereska's Thunder
Description: Affected entity has resistance to Thunder damage. Its thunder spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus. When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of  Reverberation upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's thunder, it can cast  Shatter and  Destructive Wave at 5th level once per short rest.

Name: Ruptured
Description: Take 1d4Piercing for each  1 m / 3 ft movement. Each time the damage is triggered, reduce the condition duration by 1.

Name: Sacred Defiance
Description: Affected entity has  Advantage against the effects of  Turn Undead while near the spellcaster.

Name: Sacred Defiance Aura
Description: Affected entity and nearby undead have  Advantage against the effect of Turn Undead.

Name: Sacred Flame
Description: The affected entity sheds light in 1.5m radius. It cannot become  Invisible. Enemies are more likely to target this character during the trial.

Name: Sacred Munitions
Description: Affected entity's ranged weapon attacks possibly inflict  Turn Undead on a target.

Name: Sacred Weapon
Description: Wielder's Charisma Modifier is added to Attack Rolls made with this weapon. The weapon has become magical and emits light.

Name: Sacrificed Soul
Description: The affected entity has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, and attacks against it have  Advantage while the creature that sacrificed its soul is alive.

Name: Sacrificial Lamb
Resistance: Thunder, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant
Description: Entity can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions while enveloped in vampiric magic. If Cazador draws power from all the spawns bound this way three times, he will ascend. Grants resistance to all damage types.

Name: Sanctuary
Description: Affected entity can't be targeted by enemy attacks or spells. However, it can still take damage from spells that influence a larger area. Condition ends if the affected entity attacks or harms another creature, and will receive  Sanctuary Blocked for 1 turn.

Name: Sanctuary Blocked
Description: Affected entity can't receive  Sanctuary

Name: Sanctuary of Loss
Description: The Nightbringer's dark arcana stops this entity being directly targeted by spells or attacks until it takes a harmful action. Areas of effect can still harm this entity. Viconia can still use  Heartwrench and keep this protection.

Name: Sapped
Description: Target has been psionically drained.

Name: Sapping Curse
Description: This cursed energy drains vitality of anyone who dares get closer. Any creature within range of the affected entity gains the condition  Vitality Drain, and takes 4d6+4Necrotic per turn. Take half damage on succeeding DC 8  Wisdom saving throw. Target is cursed.

Name: Savage Howl
Description: Movement Speed increased by  5 m / 17 ft. Gains  20 temporary hit points

Name: Scarlet Remittance +1
Description: Affected entity has +1 bonus to Attack rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC.

Name: Scarlet Remittance +2
Description: Affected entity has +2 bonus to Attack rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC.

Name: Scarlet Remittance +3
Description: Affected entity has +3 bonus to Attack rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC.

Name: Scarlet Saturation
Description: Your next attack is guaranteed to Critically Hit.

Name: Scarlet Stupor
Description: The next creature to roll a  Saving throw against one of your spells has  Disadvantage.

Name: Scorching Siphon
Description: A nearby fire myrmidon grants the affected entity Immunity to Fire damage and an additional 3d8Fire damage to  Elemental Retort. The affected entity also gains temporary access to  Fireball and an additional  Reaction per turn.

Name: Scratch's Sniff
Description: Scratch has discovered something of note nearby.

Name: Sea Plague
Description: Beaded and adrip with thick oily sweat, the affected entity has  Disadvantage on  Ability checks,  Saving throws, and Attack rolls using  Strength.

Name: Searing Smite
Description: Takes 1d6Fire damage per turn. The condition ends if target succeeds a Constitution  Saving throw.

Name: See Invisibility
Description: Can see Invisible creatures within  9 m / 30 ft. Creatures must succeed a Dexterity  Saving throw or lose their Invisibility.

Name: Seeming
Description: Appearance is entirely changed.

Name: Seething Fury
Description: Rage brews within the gnoll. Once it gives in to its fury, it'll be able to attack multiple times per turn. This will evolve into  Festering Frenzy and then  Frenzied Fury, which will allow the gnoll to attack three times per turn.

Name: Seized by Planar Binding
Description: Affected entity follows and fights for the one who has bound it. Every time it takes damage, it may break the caster's control over it with a successful  Wisdom saving throw.

Name: Self-Same Trial
Description: Shar has created this reflection as a test. If a creature attacks a reflection that is not their own, it incurs  Cheater's Folly.

Name: Selune's Blessing: Lunar Brand
Description: Your attacks deal an additional 1d4Radiant damage.

Name: Selune's Blessing: Moonsnare
Description: Movement speed halved.

Name: Selûne's Ire
Description: As a reaction, the Sliver can deal 12d12Radiant damage to an attacker. It can use  Selûne's Ire again after its next turn.

Name: Selûne's Seal
Description: A protective shield surrounds the chest, dealing 4d6Radiant damage to any heretics that touch it.

Name: Sentinel Foe
Description: Can't move. Restrained by an Opportunity Attack from a Sentinel.

Name: Septic
Description: Affected entity has its Constitution reduced by 1, and has  Disadvantage on Constitution  Saving throws

Name: Serpent Fang Toxin
Description: Affected entity takes 1d6Poison damage at the end of its next turn.

Name: Severe Arcane Hunger
Description: The Netherese Orb in Gale's body is severely weakening him. He has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and all  Saving throws. His movement speed is halved.

Name: Severed Soul
Description: With no soul to motivate it, the affected entity has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and all  Ability checks until  Restore Soul is cast on a Soul Pillar or Raphael.

Name: Shackled
Description: Chained to the ground with iron shackles

Name: Shadespell
Description: As long as it remains obscured, the affected entity has +1 to spell save DC.

Name: Shadow Curse
Description: Without a light source, you will take 2d4Necrotic damage every turn. This damage doubles each turn the party members are affected by the Shadow Curse.

Name: Shadow Infusion (Hound of Ill Omen)
Description: Close to another creature of the shadows. The Hound of Ill Omen has gained the Right Behind You reaction.

Name: Shadow Infusion (Accursed Spectre)
Description: Close to another creature of the shadows. The Accursed Spectre has gained the Splinter Shadow reaction.

Name: Shadow Possession
Description: Affected entity is possessed by frenzied shadows and will attack the nearest creature. Its weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4Necrotic damage.

Name: Shadow Step
Description: Affected entity has  Advantage on their next melee Attack roll

Name: Shadow Veil
Description: Because it is Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this entity is Resistant to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

Name: Shadow Visage
Description: This visage is floating in shadowy limbo. It cannot be damaged until drawn into combat.

Name: Shadow-Animated
Description: This armour is animated by shadow, increasing its Ability Scores and Hit Points.

Name: Shadow-Cursed Undead
Description: Those who die in the shadows are cursed to remain there forever. These undead have reduced Hit Points and Strength, are Resistant to Necrotic damage and cannot use Spells or Weapon Actions.

Name: Shadow-Cursed Vines
Description: Affected entity can't move and takes 1-4NecroticDRS damage per turn. Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while its Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

Name: Shapechanged
Description: This creature has shapechanged into a male human.

Name: Shar's Blessing: Barrier of Darkness
Description: You have an  Advantage on  Saving throws while in darkness or dim light.

Name: Shar's Embrace
Description: You cannot move or escape while locked in the  Dark Lady's clutches.

Name: Shar-Stricken
Description: The Lady of Loss  Hexes you, causing a temporary lapse in your agility.

Name: Sharran Retribution
Description: Shield of Faith reduces all damage by 2 and deals 1d4Necrotic damage back at the attacker.

Name: Shattered
Description: Imbued with the gnawing exhaustion of endless labour. Receives an additional 1d4Piercing when struck by the war pick Deep Delver.

Name: Shattered Psyche
Description: Armour Class is reduced by 2.

Name: Shattered Psyche (Full-illithid)
Description: Your Armour Class Armour Class is reduced by 6, you have a -5 penalty to all  Saving throws, and  Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws.

Name: Shell of Resistance
Resistance: Lightning, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Cold, Acid, Force, Necrotic, Radiant, Psychic, Poison
Description: Gortash has Immunity to Thunder damage, Resistance to physical and elemental damage for one turn, an extra bonus action and  3 m / 10 ft extra Movement Speed. Tactician only Gortash has Immunity to Fire as well.

Name: Shield
Description: Immune to Magic Missile.

Name: Shield of Faith
Description: Receives +2 bonus to Armour Class Armour Class.

Name: Shield of Screams
Description: Protected by the screams of his enemies. Attackers take 2d6Psychic damage when they hit Nere with a melee attack.

Name: Shielded
Description: Shielded from the Voice of the Absolute.

Name: Shillelagh
Description: Creature's weapon is magical and deals  1d8Bludgeoning damage. Attack rolls use the wielder's Spellcasting modifier.

Name: Shillelagh (Strengthened)
Description: Creature's weapon is magical and deals 4d8Bludgeoning damage. Attack rolls use the wielder's Spellcasting Ability Modifier. This condition is only available to the summoned Dryad

Name: Shocked
Description: Cannot take reactions and has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Saving Throws using Dexterity.

Name: Shocking Brew
Description: Affected entity deals an additional 2d6Lightning damage while infused with Thisobald's current brew.

Name: Shocking Grasp
Description: Cannot take Reactions.

Name: Shredded Armour
Description: Removed by healing.

Name: Shrouded
Description: This painting is obscured while within  6 m / 20 ft of the Judge.

Name: Shrouded Sentence
Description: The Judge is obscuring paintings within  6 m / 20 ft, preventing judgement being passed on an accused soul.

Name: Sickened
Vulnerability: Cold, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Thunder
Description: Overpowering, indescribable sickness. Vulnerable to most types of damage. Vulnerable to all damage types except Radiant

Name: Silence Aura
Description: While it remains in the aura, affected entity is  Silenced.

Name: Silenced
Description: Creature can't speak or cast spells with a verbal component, and is immune to Thunder damage.

Name: Silkroot Euphoria
Skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
Description: The creature suffers  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.

Name: Silvanus' Blessing

Name: Volatile Shield (10)
Description: Affected entity has been granted temporary hit points by an illithid. If these are removed by incoming damage, the shield bursts, possibly  Stunning nearby foes. The shield only bursts after all temporary hit points have been removed. This also removes the condition. When the shield bursts, enemies within  9 m / 30 ft are  Stunned for 1 turn, unless they succeed a DC 15  Intelligence saving throw.

Name: Volo's Guide to Monsters
Description: With steadfast application of knowledge from Volo's preeminent work, affected entitites gain +2 to Attack Rolls, Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

Name: Vow of Enmity
Description: Spellcaster has  Advantage on Attack Rolls against the affected entity.

Name: Wall of Fire
Description: A blazing wall of fire that deals 5d8Fire to anyone within  3 m / 10 ft.

Name: Wall of Fire: Aura
Description: Engulfed in a wall of blazings flames. The affected entity takes 5d8 + 1d8 per additional Spell LevelFire damage per turn it stays within  3 m / 10 ft of the fire.

Name: Wall of Thorns
Description: Walking through a wall of pliable, twisted thorns. While within the wall, the affected entity's movement speed is quartered, and it takes 7d8Piercing damage per turn.

Name: War Paint
Description: Decorated with worg dung.

Name: Warden of Vitality (Aura)
Description: Affected entity can use  Restore Vitality to heal itself or nearby allies.

Name: Warden of Vitality
Description: Close enough to a friendly paladin to be healed with  Restore Vitality.

Name: Warding Bond (Caster)
Description: Creature is bound to an ally. Each time the ally takes damage, the creature takes the same amount of damage.

Name: Warding Bond
Resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
Description: Affected entity has a +1 bonus to Armour Class and Saving throw Saving throws, and Resistance to all damage. Each time it takes damage, the spellcaster takes the same amount of damage.

Name: Wasting Brew
Description: Affected entity deals an additional 2d6Necrotic damage while infused with Thisobald's current brew.

Name: Wasting Mortal
Description: This living creature takes 4d6Necrotic at the end of every turn while it is within  The Dead Wastes. Afflicted creatures also cannot regenerate  hit points and their movement costs twice as much.

Name: Water Layer Protection
Description: Prevented from  Burning. Resistant to Fire damage. Saving throw +2

Name: Wayward Heart
Description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its Wayward Heart by acquiescing to Shar and aiding Viconia in combat.

Name: Wayward Undead
Description: Affected entity is controlled by Mystic Carrion until combat ends. When this affect ends, the entity is destroyed.

Name: Weak Grip
Description: Has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Strength  Saving throws. Removed if an ally Helps this creature.

Name: Weapon Dropped!
Description: An enemy has made you drop your weapon to the ground, similar to  Disarmed.

Name: Weapon Stolen!
Description: An enemy has taken your weapon.

Name: Weavebound Vines
Description: Vines crafted from the very Weave itself - a most unorthodox enchantment. Incapacitates the affected entity. Dispelled when the entity is attacked.

Name: Weavewalker
Description: One must remove all obstacles to follow one's destiny -  Arabella's favour grants affected creatures the benefits of  Freedom of Movement. The affected creature's Movement Speed cannot be reduced by Difficult Terrain, spells or magical effects. The affected creature cannot be  Paralysed or  Restrained.

Name: Wet
Description: Immune to  Burning and  Wild Magic: Burning. Resistant to Fire damage. Vulnerable to Lightning and Cold damage.

Name: Whirlwind
Description: Creatures in this whirlwind may become  Restrained ( Strength saving throw)

Name: Whispers of Madness
Skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
Description: Dark whispers pervade the creature's mind.  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.

Name: Wholeness of Body
Description: Affected entity has an extra  Bonus Action and recovers 1  Ki Point every turn.

Name: Wild Magic: Burning
Description: Takes 1d6Fire damage at the start of each turn.

Name: Wild Magic: Cat Form
Description: Flickering, unreliable magic has polymorphed you into a cat.

Name: Wild Magic: Dark Tendrils
Description: Each creature within  9 m / 30 ft of you must succeed a  Constitution saving throw or take 1d12Necrotic damage. Additionally, you gain  1d12 temporary hit points. The DC is based off your Charisma modifier

Name: Wild Magic: Dog Form
Description: Flickering, unreliable magic has polymorphed you into a dog.

Name: Wild Magic: Enchant Weapons
Description: The next attack with this weapon is a Critical Hit and deals an additional 1d4Force.

Name: Wild Magic: Explosive Healing
Description: Your spells of Level 1 and higher heal all creatures in a  3 m / 10 ft radius for 1d4hit points hit points per Spell Slot level.

Name: Wild Magic: Intangible Spirit
Description: Can summon an  Intangible Spirit each turn, until the end of their  Rage.

Name: Wild Magic: Light Bolt
Description: Can shoot a  Bolt of Light from their chest each turn, until the end of their  Rage.

Name: Wild Magic: Magic Retribution
Description: Until the end of the barbarian's Rage, enemies that hit them take 1d6Force damage in retaliation.

Name: Wild Magic: Protective Lights (Aura)
Description: Protected by multicoloured lights. Until the end of the barbarian's  Rage, the barbarian and any allies within  3 m / 10 ft have a +1 bonus to  Armour Class.

Name: Wild Magic: Protective Lights
Description: Surrounded by a barbarian's wild magic. Has a +1 bonus to  Armour Class until the end of the barbarian's  Rage.

Name: Wild Magic: Sorcery Points
Description: Each spell you cast restores Sorcery Points equal to its Spell Slot level.

Name: Wild Magic: Swap
Description: Casting a spell or cantrip makes you switch positions with a targeted creature.

Name: Wild Magic: Telekinesis
Description: You are able to use Telekinesis without expending a spell slot.

Name: Wild Magic: Teleport
Description: Can use a  Bonus Action to teleport up to  9 m / 30 ft.

Name: Wild Magic: Teleport (Barbarian)
Description: Can  Teleport each turn, until the end of their  Rage.

Name: Wild Magic: Turn Magic
Description: At the start of each turn, triggers a random magical effect.

Name: Wild Magic: Vine Growth
Description: Surrounded by flowers and vines Until the end of the barbarian's Rage, the ground within  5 m / 17 ft is  Difficult Terrain for everyone other than the barbarian, halving Movement Speed

Name: Wild Magic: Weapon Infusion
Description: Magic infuses this weapon. Until the end of the barbarian's Rage, it deals an additional 1d6Force damage and gains the  Light and  Thrown properties. If thrown, it immediately reappears in the barbarian's hand.

Name: Wilted Dreams
Description: The target takes 3d6Psychic damage during next Long Rest.

Name: Witch Bolt
Description: The spellcaster can use an Action each turn to activate the arc linking it to this creature to automatically deal 1d12Lightning damage.

Name: Withering Barrier
Description: If the affected entity is hit with a melee attack while it still has temporary hit points, it deals 1d6Piercing to creatures within  3 m / 10 ft.

Name: Withering Life Force
Description: Stole a creature's life force and gained  20 temporary hit points. Reconstituted Arcanists can hand their Withering Life Force to other creatures.

Name: Within the Mind Sanctuary
Description: Affected entity can take actions and bonus actions interchangeably, as long as it stays within the mind sanctuary. After using both action and bonus action, this condition ends and you gain the  Mind Sanctuary: Depleted condition.

Name: Witness
Description: Witnessed the murder of a guard and will report to other guards as soon as possible.

Name: Wizardsbane Oil
Description: Affected entity has -3 penalty to Spell Attack Rolls and Spell Save DC  Disadvantage on  Concentration Saving Throws

Name: Wound Closure
Description: While unconscious, the affected entity stabilises at the start of its turn.

Name: Wrath
Description: You have a +1 bonus to damage with melee weapons for every turn this condition has remaining.

Name: Wrathful Spirits
Vulnerability: Poison, Thunder, Radiant, Psychic, Necrotic, Lightning, Force, Fire, Cold, Acid, Slashing, Piercing, Bludgeoning
Description: Spiritual energy has  Frightened this creature and is making it Vulnerable to all damage.

Name: Wretched Growth
Description: Affected entity will take 3d10Necrotic and possibly become  Entangled by Shadow-Cursed Vines if it ends its turn within  5 m / 17 ft of the Shambling Mound. On save, the affected entity still takes half damage.

Name: Writhing Souls
Description: While stood within the  Soul Ascension, this non-fiend will take 6d10Necrotic every turn as its soul is rended.

Name: Writhing Tide
Description: Your swarm is protecting you from surface effects.

Name: Wyvern Toxin
Description: Affected entity takes 1d8Poison damage at the end of its next turn.

Name: Yeenoghu's Blessing
Description: Indulged its lust for violence. Yeenoghu's Gift won't turn the affected creature  Mad.

Name: Yeenoghu's Gift
Description: Famished for slaughter. Affected entity can go  Mad for 2 turns if it doesn't deal damage to an enemy by the end of its turn.

Name: Yeenoghu's Hunger
Description: Bloated with the spoils of slaughter, but still hungry - a gnoll is growing in the hyena's belly.

Name: Zariel's Protection
Description: When attacked, Mizora will disappear to the Hells and return after a minute.
